        "quantities": quantities,
        "components": {
            "pchase": {"component_id": "pchase", "required": True, "harness_identity_ids": ["harness-main"], "build_relationship_ids": ["build-rel-main"], "quantity_ids": pchase_ids},
            "roster_control_sidecars": {
                "component_id": "roster_control_sidecars", "required": True, "expected_inventory_id": "control-inventory", "expected_binary_count": 1,
                "members": [{"binary_id": "binary-main", "binary_identity_id": "binary-main", "expected_sidecar_id": "control.calibration-main", "witness_slug": "calibration_main", "shape_point": "m5_locked"}],
            },
        },
        "policy": {
            "ncu_cross_check_only": True, "ncu_derivation_forbidden": True, "ncu_selection_forbidden": True,
            "ncu_tuning_forbidden": True, "ncu_transcription_forbidden": True, "simulator_fit_forbidden": True,
            "architecture_card_write_forbidden": True, "publication_mode": "ADDITIVE_EVIDENCE_ONLY",
        },
    }


def _control_record() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "pc": 0, "predicate": None, "opcode_text": "MOV R0, R0", "low_word": "0x0000000000000000", "high_word": "0x0000000000000000",
        "control": {"stall": 0, "yield_flag": 0, "write_barrier": 0, "read_barrier": 0, "wait_mask": 0, "reuse": 0}, "status": "decoded",
    }


def _sidecar(function_name: str, binary_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "arch": "sm_86", "functions": {function_name: [_control_record()]}, "skipped_arch_sections": [],
        "parser_contract": copy.deepcopy(m5.CONTROL_PARSER_CONTRACT), "toolkit_version": "V13.2.0", "binary": binary_name,
        "summary": {"functions": {function_name: {"instructions": 1, "decoded": 1, "unknown_encoding": 0, "stall_cycles_static_sum": 0}}, "total_decoded": 1, "total_unknown_encoding": 0},
    }


def _full_join_cell(member: Mapping[str, Any], function_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "identity": {"slug": member["slug"], "shape_point": member["shape_point"], "binary_sha256": member["binary_sha256"]},
        "first_launch": "kernel_1", "vpc_low32_mismatches": 0, "n_instruction_records": 1,
        "functions": [{
            "function_unique_id": 1, "kernel_name": f"{function_name}___0", "sass_function": function_name, "status": "joined",
            "n_traced_pcs": 1, "n_joined": 1, "n_decoded": 1, "missing_pcs": [],
            "sample": {"pc": 0, "opcode_text": "MOV R0, R0", "control": _control_record()["control"]},
        }],
        "coverage": {"n_traced_pcs": 1, "n_joined": 1, "n_decoded": 1, "full_join": True},
    }


def _typed_join_cell(member: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "identity": {"slug": member["slug"], "shape_point": member["shape_point"], "binary_sha256": member["binary_sha256"]},
        "status": "typed", "typed_reason": "binary_or_trace_unresolved",
    }


class CampaignBuilder:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, run: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.run = run
        self.counter = 0
        self.repetition_counter = 0

    def authenticated(self, artifact_id: str, payload: bytes, role: str, context_id: str, media_type: str = "application/json") -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], Path]:
        self.counter += 1
        artifact_path = _write(self.root / "analysis-inputs" / f"artifact-{self.counter:04d}", payload)
        digest = immutable.sha256_bytes(payload)
        reference = m5._artifact_reference(artifact_id, digest, len(payload), media_type)
        unsigned = {
            "schema_version": 1, "artifact_kind": "M5_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT", "authority_identity_id": "m5-analysis-authority",
            "run_model_seal_sha256": self.run["model_seal_sha256"], "source_commit": self.run["source_state"]["source_commit"],
            "artifact_id": artifact_id, "artifact_sha256": digest, "artifact_size_bytes": len(payload), "artifact_media_type": media_type,
            "artifact_role": role, "context_id": context_id,
        }
        signature = _sign(m5._RECEIPT_DOMAIN + immutable.canonical_json_bytes(unsigned))
        receipt = {**unsigned, "signature_ed25519": signature.hex()}
        receipt_id = f"receipt.{self.counter:04d}.{hashlib.sha256(context_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]}"
        receipt_path = _write_json(self.root / "analysis-inputs" / f"receipt-{self.counter:04d}.json", receipt)
        return {
            "artifact_input": _input(artifact_id, artifact_path, media_type),
            "receipt_input": _input(receipt_id, receipt_path),
        }, reference, artifact_path

    def repetitions(self) -> list[str]:
        result = []
        for _ in range(3):
            self.repetition_counter += 1
            result.append(f"rep-{self.repetition_counter:04d}")
        return result

    def build(self) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Path]]:
        quantity_results = []
        repetition_ids: list[str] = []
        producer_paths: dict[str, Path] = {}
        for quantity in self.run["quantities"]:
            quantity_id = quantity["quantity_id"]
            evidence: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
            evidence_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
            for role in m5.EVIDENCE_ROLES:
                artifact_id = f"evidence.{quantity_id}.{role}"
                evidence_ids[role] = artifact_id
                payload = immutable.pretty_json_bytes({"artifact_kind": "M5_TEST_EVIDENCE", "quantity_id": quantity_id, "role": role})
                auth, _reference, _path = self.authenticated(artifact_id, payload, f"EVIDENCE_{role.upper()}", f"{quantity_id}.{role}.0")
                evidence[role] = [auth]
            readout_inputs = []
            producer_hashes = []
            for contract in quantity["readout_contracts"]:
                repetitions = self.repetitions()
                repetition_ids.extend(repetitions)
                probability = quantity["value_domain"]["kind"] == "PROBABILITY"
                observations = [
                    {
                        "repetition_id": repetition,
                        "launch_id": f"launch-{repetition}",
                        "numerator": 1 if probability else 10,
                        "denominator": 2 if probability else 1,
                    }
                    for repetition in repetitions
                ]
                lineage_id = f"lineage.{contract['readout_id']}"
                raw_sample = {
                    "schema_version": 1,
                    "artifact_kind": "M5_RAW_SAMPLE_SERIES",
                    "run_model_seal_sha256": self.run["model_seal_sha256"],
                    "quantity_id": quantity_id,
                    "readout_id": contract["readout_id"],
                    "method_class": contract["method_class"],
                    "instrument": contract["instrument"],
                    "source_lineage_id": lineage_id,
                    "harness_identity_id": "harness-main",
                    "build_relationship_id": "build-rel-main",
                    "binary_identity_id": "binary-main",
                    "observations": observations,
                    "ncu_ancestor_artifact_ids": [],
                    "simulator_ancestor_artifact_ids": [],
                }
                raw_id = f"raw.{contract['readout_id']}"
                raw_auth, raw_reference, raw_path = self.authenticated(
                    raw_id,
                    immutable.pretty_json_bytes(raw_sample),
                    "RAW_SAMPLE_SERIES",
                    contract["readout_id"],
                )
                producer = {
                    "schema_version": 1, "artifact_kind": "M5_READOUT_PRODUCER", "run_model_seal_sha256": self.run["model_seal_sha256"],
                    "quantity_id": quantity_id, "readout_id": contract["readout_id"], "method_class": contract["method_class"],
                    "instrument": contract["instrument"], "derivation_identity_id": contract["derivation_identity_id"],
                    "derivation_operation": contract["derivation_operation"], "unit": quantity["unit"], "input_class": contract["instrument"],
                    "sample_operation": contract["sample_operation"], "raw_sample_artifact_sha256": raw_reference["sha256"],
                    "source_lineage_id": lineage_id,
                    "evidence_artifact_ids": [evidence_ids[role] for role in contract["required_evidence_roles"]],
                    "ncu_artifact_ids": [], "simulator_artifact_ids": [],
                }
                payload = immutable.pretty_json_bytes(producer)
                producer_id = f"producer.{contract['readout_id']}"
                producer_auth, reference, path = self.authenticated(producer_id, payload, "READOUT_PRODUCER", contract["readout_id"])
                producer_paths[contract["readout_id"]] = path
                producer_paths[f"raw.{contract['readout_id']}"] = raw_path
                readout_inputs.append({"raw_sample": raw_auth, "producer": producer_auth})
                producer_hashes.append(reference["sha256"])
            decision = {
                "schema_version": 1, "artifact_kind": "M5_QUANTITY_DECISION", "run_model_seal_sha256": self.run["model_seal_sha256"],
                "quantity_id": quantity_id, "readout_producer_sha256s": producer_hashes, "outcome": {"kind": "MEASURED"},
                "ncu_artifact_ids": [], "simulator_artifact_ids": [],
            }
            decision_auth, _ref, _path = self.authenticated(f"decision.{quantity_id}", immutable.pretty_json_bytes(decision), "QUANTITY_DECISION", quantity_id)
            quantity_results.append({"quantity_id": quantity_id, "evidence": evidence, "readout_inputs": readout_inputs, "decision": decision_auth, "cross_checks": []})

        def state(observation_id: str, phase: str, repetition_id: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
            return {
                "observation_id": observation_id, "observation_phase": phase, "repetition_id": repetition_id,
                "sm_clock_mhz": 1350, "memory_clock_mhz": 10501, "persistence_mode": True, "clock_locked": True,
                "cache_control": "all", "driver_version": "610.43.02", "throttle_reasons": [],
            }

        protocol = {
            "schema_version": 1, "artifact_kind": "M5_PROTOCOL_STATE_WITNESS", "run_model_seal_sha256": self.run["model_seal_sha256"],
            "source_commit": self.run["source_state"]["source_commit"], "protocol_identity_id": "m5-campaign-protocol",
            "m0": state("obs-m0", "M0", None), "global_pre": state("obs-global-pre", "PRE", None), "global_post": state("obs-global-post", "POST", None),
            "repetitions": [{"repetition_id": repetition, "pre": state(f"obs-pre-{repetition}", "PRE", repetition), "post": state(f"obs-post-{repetition}", "POST", repetition)} for repetition in repetition_ids],
        }
        protocol_auth, _ref, protocol_path = self.authenticated("m5-protocol-state-witness", immutable.pretty_json_bytes(protocol), "PROTOCOL_STATE_WITNESS", "protocol-state")

        def control_group(members: list[Mapping[str, Any]], group_id: str, witness_id: str, complete_first_only: bool) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], Path]:
            cells = []
            entries = []
            full_count = 0
            for index, member in enumerate(members):
                function_name = f"function_{group_id.lower()}_{index}"
                sidecar_auth, _reference, _path = self.authenticated(
                    member["expected_sidecar_id"], immutable.pretty_json_bytes(_sidecar(function_name, member["cell_id"])), "CONTROL_SIDECAR", member["cell_id"]
                )
                entries.append({"cell_id": member["cell_id"], "expected_sidecar_id": member["expected_sidecar_id"], "sidecar": sidecar_auth})
                complete = index == 0 if complete_first_only else True
                if complete:
                    cells.append(_full_join_cell(member, function_name))
                    full_count += 1
                else:
                    cells.append(_typed_join_cell(member))
            witness = {
                "schema_version": 1, "artifact_kind": "sass_control_pc_join_witness", "arch": "sm_86",
                "source_commit": self.run["source_state"]["source_commit"], "n_cells": len(cells), "n_full_join": full_count, "cells": cells,
            }
            witness_auth, _reference, path = self.authenticated(witness_id, immutable.pretty_json_bytes(witness), "CONTROL_PC_JOIN_WITNESS", group_id)
            return {"pc_join_witness": witness_auth, "entries": entries}, path

        canonical_members = self.run["components"]["canonical_runnable_roster"]["members"]
        calibration_members = self.run["components"]["roster_control_sidecars"]["calibration_members"]
        canonical_controls, canonical_witness_path = control_group(canonical_members, "CANONICAL_ROSTER", "canonical-pc-join-witness", True)
        calibration_controls, calibration_witness_path = control_group(calibration_members, "CALIBRATION_BINARIES", "calibration-pc-join-witness", False)
        request = {
            "schema_version": 1, "request_kind": "M5_ANALYSIS_REQUEST", "run_model_seal_sha256": self.run["model_seal_sha256"],
            "protocol_state_witness": protocol_auth, "quantity_results": quantity_results,
            "roster_control_sidecars": {"canonical": canonical_controls, "calibration": calibration_controls},
        }
        return request, {"protocol": protocol_path, "canonical_witness": canonical_witness_path, "calibration_witness": calibration_witness_path, **producer_paths}


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
def _stable_source() -> None:
    monkeypatch = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    monkeypatch.setattr(m5, "_observe_git_source", lambda: (_COMMIT, b""))
    yield
    monkeypatch.undo()


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def campaign(tmp_path_factory: pytest.TempPathFactory) -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("m5-campaign")
    request_path = _write_json(root / "plan-request.json", _plan_request(root))
    run_bundle = m5.plan(request_path, root / "run-publications")
    run = json.loads((run_bundle / "RUN.json").read_text())
    builder = CampaignBuilder(root, run)
    analysis_request, input_paths = builder.build()
    analysis_path = _write_json(root / "analysis-request.json", analysis_request)
    final_bundle = m5.analyze(run_bundle, analysis_path, root / "result-publications")
    public, _scalar, _prefix = _test_key()
    return {
        "root": root, "run_bundle": run_bundle, "run": run, "analysis_path": analysis_path,
        "analysis_request": analysis_request, "input_paths": input_paths, "bundle": final_bundle,
        "authority_sha256": immutable.sha256_bytes(public),
    }


def _bundle_models(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    bundle = campaign["bundle"]
    values = [json.loads((bundle / name).read_text()) for name in ("RUN.json", "RESULT.json", "DONE.json")]
    return values[0], values[1], values[2]


def test_plan_analyze_relocate_and_verify(campaign: Mapping[str, Any], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    run, result, done = _bundle_models(campaign)
    assert run["family_execution_order"] == ["b", "a", "d", "f", "c", "e"]
    assert run["family_scientific_rank"] == ["b", "f", "a", "d", "c", "e"]
    assert run["counts"]["quantity_count"] == 31
    assert run["counts"]["canonical_runnable_cell_count"] == 122
    assert result["counts"]["measured_quantity_count"] == 31
    assert result["counts"]["canonical_control_sidecar_count"] == 122
    assert result["components"]["pchase"]["property_count"] == 14
    assert done["counts"]["authority_receipt_count"] == len(result["authenticity"]["entries"])
    relocated = tmp_path / "relocated"
    shutil.copytree(campaign["bundle"], relocated)
    verified = m5.verify(relocated, campaign["authority_sha256"])
    assert verified["model_seal_sha256"] == done["model_seal_sha256"]


def test_verify_requires_out_of_band_authority(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(m5.M5ContractError, match="out-of-band trust anchor"):
        m5.verify(campaign["bundle"], "0" * 64)


def test_closed_roster_normalizes_uppercase_without_alias(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    members = campaign["run"]["components"]["canonical_runnable_roster"]["members"]
    assert len(members) == 122
    assert len({member["cell_id"] for member in members}) == 122
    assert all(m5._SAFE_ID.fullmatch(member["cell_id"]) for member in members)
    uppercase = [member for member in members if any(character.isupper() for character in member["slug"])]
    assert uppercase
    assert all(member["cell_id"] == member["cell_id"].lower() for member in uppercase)


def test_result_rederives_readouts_not_caller_values(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    run, result, _done = _bundle_models(campaign)
    quantity = run["quantities"][0]
    readout = copy.deepcopy(result["quantity_results"][0]["readouts"][0])
    readout["value"] += 1
    loader = m5._DeclaredSnapshotLoader(root=campaign["bundle"])
    try:
        with pytest.raises(m5.M5ContractError, match="not rederived"):
            m5._rederive_readout(run, quantity, quantity["readout_contracts"][0], readout, loader)
    finally:
        loader.close()


def test_raw_sample_repetition_cardinality_is_exact(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    run, result, _done = _bundle_models(campaign)
    quantity = run["quantities"][0]
    readout = result["quantity_results"][0]["readouts"][0]
    raw_sample = json.loads(
        (campaign["bundle"] / readout["raw_sample_artifact"]["relative_path"]).read_text()
    )
    raw_sample["observations"][1]["repetition_id"] = raw_sample["observations"][0][
        "repetition_id"
    ]
    modified = immutable.pretty_json_bytes(raw_sample)

    def loader(reference: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bytes:
        if reference["artifact_id"] == readout["raw_sample_artifact"]["artifact_id"]:
            return modified
        return immutable.read_relative(campaign["bundle"], reference["relative_path"])

    with pytest.raises(m5.M5ContractError, match="duplicates a repetition"):
        m5._rederive_readout(run, quantity, quantity["readout_contracts"][0], readout, loader)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("quantity_id", "value", "match"),
    [
        ("pchase.l1_capacity_bytes", -1, "positive"),
        ("pchase.l1_capacity_bytes", 1.5, "integral"),
        ("a.l2_pair_fill_probability", 1.1, r"\[0,1\]"),
        ("e.l2_slice_hash_structure", -0.1, "nonnegative"),
    ],
)
def test_quantity_domains_are_closed(quantity_id: str, value: float, match: str) -> None:
    quantity = next(row for row in m5._quantity_authority_model()["quantities"] if row["quantity_id"] == quantity_id)
    with pytest.raises(m5.M5ContractError, match=match):
        m5._quantity_number(quantity, value, quantity_id)


def test_protocol_covers_every_readout_repetition(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    _run, result, _done = _bundle_models(campaign)
    expected = sum(readout["sample_count"] for row in result["quantity_results"] for readout in row["readouts"])
    protocol = result["components"]["protocol_state"]
    assert protocol["repetition_count"] == expected == 186
    assert protocol["all_state_joins_passed"] is True


def test_control_inputs_are_real_standard_sidecars_and_pc_witnesses(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    _run, result, _done = _bundle_models(campaign)
    controls = result["components"]["roster_control_sidecars"]
    assert controls["observed_canonical_cell_count"] == 122
    assert controls["observed_calibration_binary_count"] == 1
    assert controls["entries"][0]["status"] == "COMPLETE"
    assert any(entry["status"] == "TYPED" for entry in controls["entries"][1:122])
    sidecar = json.loads((campaign["bundle"] / controls["entries"][0]["sidecar"]["relative_path"]).read_text())
    assert set(sidecar) == {"arch", "functions", "skipped_arch_sections", "parser_contract", "toolkit_version", "binary", "summary"}


def test_done_inventory_contains_receipts_producers_and_decisions(campaign: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    _run, result, done = _bundle_models(campaign)
    bindings = {binding for row in done["artifact_inventory"] for binding in row["bindings"]}
    assert {"AUTHORITY_RECEIPT", "READOUT_PRODUCER", "QUANTITY_DECISION", "PCHASE_FRESH_CARD"}.issubset(bindings)
    receipt_ids = {row["receipt"]["artifact_id"] for row in result["authenticity"]["entries"]}
    inventory_ids = {row["artifact_id"] for row in done["artifact_inventory"]}
    assert receipt_ids.issubset(inventory_ids)


def test_artifact_relative_path_is_canonical() -> None:
    reference = m5._artifact_reference("artifact", "a" * 64, 1, "text/plain")
    reference["relative_path"] = "artifacts/bad/artifact"
    with pytest.raises(m5.M5ContractError, match="canonical content-addressed"):
        m5._collect_artifact({}, reference, "artifact")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("payload", "match"),
    [
        (b'{"x":1,"x":2}', "duplicate"),
        (b'{"x":NaN}', "non-finite"),
        (b'{"x":9007199254740992}', "safe range"),
        (b'{"x":9007199254740993.0}', "float exceeds"),
        (b'{"x":"\\ud800"}', "surrogate"),
    ],
)
def test_strict_json_rejects_ambiguous_values(payload: bytes, match: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(immutable.ImmutableArtifactError, match=match):
        immutable.strict_json_loads(payload)


def test_strict_json_types_deep_nesting() -> None:
    payload = ("[" * 3000 + "0" + "]" * 3000).encode()
    with pytest.raises(immutable.ImmutableArtifactError, match="invalid|nesting"):
        immutable.strict_json_loads(payload)


def test_invalid_ed25519_authority_is_rejected(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    request = _plan_request(tmp_path)
    authority = next(identity for identity in request["identities"] if identity["identity_id"] == "m5-analysis-authority")
    Path(authority["artifact_input"]["path"]).write_bytes(bytes(32))
    path = _write_json(tmp_path / "request.json", request)
    with pytest.raises(m5.M5ContractError, match="prime-order"):
        m5.plan(path, tmp_path / "out")


def test_direct_collect_refuses_before_optional_imports(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    script = Path(m5.__file__).resolve()
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-S", str(script), "collect", "--output", str(tmp_path / "never")],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 2
    assert completed.stderr == "M5_COLLECT_DISABLED\n"
    assert not (tmp_path / "never").exists()


def test_collect_function_refuses_without_side_effect(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    marker = tmp_path / "marker"
    with pytest.raises(m5.M5ContractError, match="M5_COLLECT_DISABLED"):
        m5.collect(marker)
    assert not marker.exists()


def test_schemas_are_closed_draft_2020_12() -> None:
    for kind, path in m5.SCHEMA_PATHS.items():
        schema = json.loads(path.read_text())
        Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
        assert schema["$id"] == m5.SCHEMA_IDS[kind]
        assert schema["additionalProperties"] is False
        assert immutable.sha256_file(path)[0] == m5.SCHEMA_SHA256_V1[kind]


def test_read_regular_rejects_symlink_and_hardlink(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    original = _write(tmp_path / "original", b"bytes")
    symlink = tmp_path / "symlink"
    symlink.symlink_to(original)
    hardlink = tmp_path / "hardlink"
    os.link(original, hardlink)
    with pytest.raises(immutable.ImmutableArtifactError, match="regular file"):
        immutable.read_regular(symlink)
    with pytest.raises(immutable.ImmutableArtifactError, match="hard-linked"):
        immutable.read_regular(hardlink)


def test_publication_is_readonly_and_idempotent(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    payload = b"immutable\n"
    file = immutable.ImmutableFile.from_bytes("nested/value.bin", payload)
    output = tmp_path / "out"
    first = immutable.publish_directory(output, "final", [file])
    second = immutable.publish_directory(output, "final", [file])
    assert first == second
    assert (first / "nested" / "value.bin").read_bytes() == payload
    assert not (first.stat().st_mode & 0o222)
    assert not ((first / "nested" / "value.bin").stat().st_mode & 0o222)


def test_verify_pins_nested_inode_through_final_inventory(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "tree"
    nested = root / "nested"
    nested.mkdir(parents=True)
    target = _write(nested / "value", b"old")
    target.chmod(0o444)
    file = immutable.ImmutableFile("nested/value", immutable.sha256_bytes(b"old"), 3, source_path=target)
    original = immutable._verify_open_file
    replaced = False

    def replace_after_hash(descriptor: int, expected: immutable.ImmutableFile) -> bool:
        nonlocal replaced
        result = original(descriptor, expected)
        if not replaced:
            replaced = True
            target.unlink()
            target.write_bytes(b"old")
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(immutable, "_verify_open_file", replace_after_hash)
    with pytest.raises(immutable.ImmutableArtifactError, match="path changed"):
        immutable.verify_published_files(root, [file], require_readonly_directories=False)

def _make_tree_readonly(root: Path) -> None:
    paths = list(root.rglob("*"))
    for path in paths:
        if path.is_file():
            path.chmod(0o444)
    for path in sorted(
        (path for path in paths if path.is_dir()),
        key=lambda item: len(item.parts),
        reverse=True,
    ):
        path.chmod(0o555)
    root.chmod(0o555)


def _sidecar_for_slot(schedule: dict, slot: dict, *, value: object = 0.5) -> dict:
    cell = next(item for item in schedule["cells"] if item["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"])

        "ncu_replay_mode": "kernel",
        "ncu_target_processes": "all",
        "ncu_filter_mode": "global",
        "ncu_profile_from_start": False,
        "ncu_launch_skip": 0,
        "ncu_launch_count": 1,
        "host_persistence_mode": "Enabled",
        "host_sm_clock_mhz": 1350 if config["reference"] else 1700,
        "host_mem_clock_mhz": 10501,
        "host_temperature_c": 61,
    }
    return {
        "schema_version": 5,
        "device": "sm_86",

        "shape_point": cell["shape_point"],

        "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector": value,

            "upper": value,
            "confidence_level": 0.95,
            "units": "sector_hit_rate_fraction",
            "aggregation": "kernel",
        },

    }

def test_completion_and_typed_exclusions_are_nonvacuous(schedule: dict) -> None:
    base = {
        "tier1_pending": 0,
        "trigger_state": "decided",
        "triggered_cells": 0,
        "tier2_pending": 0,
    }
    assert campaign._completion_state(
        **base,
        observed_slots=0,
        excluded_typed_slots=8_540,
        missing_selected_rows=469_700,
    ) == "incomplete_evidence"
    assert campaign._completion_state(
        **base,
        observed_slots=8_540,
        excluded_typed_slots=0,
        missing_selected_rows=1,
    ) == "incomplete_evidence"
    assert campaign._completion_state(
        **base,
        observed_slots=8_540,
        excluded_typed_slots=0,
        missing_selected_rows=0,
    ) == "complete"

    slot = schedule["slots"][0]
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as stop_cost:
        campaign.build_excluded_event(
            slot,
            reason="operator_stop",
            detail="operator requested pause",
            fresh_processes=1,
        )
    assert stop_cost.value.code == "M6_TYPED_EXCLUSION_CONTRACT"
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as missing_cost:
        campaign.build_excluded_event(
            slot,
            reason="sidecar_missing",
            detail="capture returned no sidecar",
        )
    assert missing_cost.value.code == "M6_TYPED_EXCLUSION_CONTRACT"

    invalid = campaign.build_excluded_event(
        slot,
        reason="profile_failed",
        detail="profiler exited nonzero",
        fresh_processes=1,
    )
    invalid["cost"]["fresh_processes"] = 0
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as resealed_invalid:
        campaign.build_journal(schedule, [invalid], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME)
    assert resealed_invalid.value.code == "M6_TYPED_EXCLUSION_CONTRACT"

def test_dispersion_lockstep_scale_invariance_and_exact_d2() -> None:
    values = [10.0, 11.0, 9.0, 10.5, 9.5]
    assert dispersion_gate("stddev_abs", values) == pytest.approx(0.7905694150420949)
    assert dispersion_gate("coefficient_of_variation", values) == pytest.approx(
        dispersion_gate("coefficient_of_variation", [value * 100 for value in values])
    )
    assert sigma_rel("stddev_abs", values) == pytest.approx(
        sigma_rel("stddev_abs", [value * 100 for value in values])
    )
    assert sigma_rel("relative_tolerance", values) == pytest.approx(
        sigma_rel("relative_tolerance", [value * 100 for value in values])
    )
    assert [d2_for_n(n) for n in (5, 10, 20, 30)] == [2.326, 3.078, 3.735, 4.086]
    assert sigma_upper_factor(10) == pytest.approx(1.65, rel=0.04)
    assert sigma_upper_factor(20) == pytest.approx(1.37, rel=0.04)
    assert sigma_upper_factor(30) == pytest.approx(1.28, rel=0.04)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error):
        campaign._number(True, role="test")


def test_single_support_split_never_certifies_multimodal() -> None:

        absolute_resolution=0.0001,
        tier2=False,

    assert result.outlier_flag is True
    assert result.certified is False


def test_continuous_multimodality_only_certifies_at_tier2() -> None:
    values = [1.0 + index * 0.0001 for index in range(15)] + [
        2.0 + index * 0.0001 for index in range(15)
    ]
    tier1 = modality_result(
        values[:20], discrete=False, absolute_resolution=0.0001, tier2=False
    )
    tier2 = modality_result(
        values, discrete=False, absolute_resolution=0.0001, tier2=True
    )
    assert tier1.certified is False
    assert tier2.flagged is True
    assert tier2.certified is True
    assert tier2.reason == "continuous_largest_gap_delta_bic"

def test_anchored_input_snapshot_rejects_ancestor_symlink_and_same_size_mutation(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    real = tmp_path / "real"
    nested = real / "nested"
    nested.mkdir(parents=True)
    document = nested / "document.json"
    document.write_text('{"value":1}\n', encoding="utf-8")
    alias = tmp_path / "alias"
    alias.symlink_to(real, target_is_directory=True)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as ancestor_error:
        campaign.load_json(alias / "nested" / "document.json", role="ancestor test")
    assert ancestor_error.value.code == "M6_INPUT_SNAPSHOT"

    hardlink_source = tmp_path / "hardlink-source.bin"
    hardlink_alias = tmp_path / "hardlink-alias.bin"
    hardlink_source.write_bytes(b"possibly unique")
    hardlink_alias.hardlink_to(hardlink_source)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as hardlink_error:
        campaign._read_regular(hardlink_source, role="hardlink test")
    assert hardlink_error.value.code == "M6_INPUT_SNAPSHOT"

    large = tmp_path / "large.bin"
    large.write_bytes(b"a" * ((1 << 20) + 1))
    original_read = campaign.immutable.os.read
    mutated = False

    def mutate_after_first_block(descriptor: int, size: int) -> bytes:
        nonlocal mutated
        block = original_read(descriptor, size)
        if block and not mutated:
            mutated = True
            with large.open("r+b") as stream:
                stream.seek(-1, 2)
                stream.write(b"b")
                stream.flush()
                campaign.os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        return block

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.immutable.os, "read", mutate_after_first_block)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as mutation_error:
        campaign._read_regular(large, role="same-size mutation")
    assert mutation_error.value.code == "M6_INPUT_SNAPSHOT"


def test_single_file_publication_handles_zero_write_and_preserves_replacement(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    original_write = campaign.os.write
    zero_out = tmp_path / "zero.json"
    zero_partial = tmp_path / ".zero.json.m6-partial"
    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.os, "write", lambda _fd, _view: 0)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as zero_error:
        campaign._write_new(zero_out, {"value": 1})
    assert zero_error.value.code == "M6_OUTPUT_WRITE"
    assert not zero_out.exists()
    assert not zero_partial.exists()

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.os, "write", original_write)
    race_out = tmp_path / "race.json"
    race_partial = tmp_path / ".race.json.m6-partial"
    replaced = False

    def replace_partial_then_fail(descriptor: int, view: memoryview) -> int:
        nonlocal replaced
        if not replaced:
            replaced = True
            race_partial.unlink()
            race_partial.write_bytes(b"foreign evidence")
        return 0

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.os, "write", replace_partial_then_fail)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as replacement_error:
        campaign._write_new(race_out, {"value": 1})
    assert replacement_error.value.code == "M6_OUTPUT_WRITE"
    assert not race_out.exists()
    assert race_partial.read_bytes() == b"foreign evidence"

def test_event_transaction_rejects_generation_mixing(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    slot = next(
        item for item in schedule["slots"]
        if item["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG
    )
    sidecar_path = tmp_path / "label.json"
    sentinel = tmp_path / "unreferenced-evidence.bin"
    _write_json(sidecar_path, _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot))
    sentinel.write_bytes(b"before")
    original = campaign._sidecar_ref_and_observations
    mutated = False

    def mutate_unreferenced_generation(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        nonlocal mutated
        result = original(*args, **kwargs)
        if not mutated:
            mutated = True
            sentinel.write_bytes(b"after!")
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        campaign,
        "_sidecar_ref_and_observations",
        mutate_unreferenced_generation,
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_observed_event(
            schedule,
            slot,
            [sidecar_path],
            journal_dir=tmp_path,
            observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
            ncu_replay_pass_count=1,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_TREE_CHANGED"


def _artifact(path: Path, root: Path, kind: str) -> dict:
    payload = path.read_bytes()
    return {
        "artifact_kind": kind,
        "relative_path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
        "sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(payload),
        "size_bytes": len(payload),
    }


def _m4_sidecar(matrix: dict, matrix_cell: dict, schedule_cell: dict) -> dict:
    registry = json.loads(campaign._git_blob_bytes(
        campaign.REPO_ROOT,
        matrix["source_commit"],
        campaign.REGISTRY_PATH.relative_to(campaign.REPO_ROOT).as_posix(),
        role="fixture source registry",
    ))
    units = {row["ncu_metric"]: row["unit"] for row in registry["metrics"]}
    invocation = matrix_cell["invocation"]
    launch_index = invocation["capture_launch_contract"]["label_launch_index"]
    profile_from_start = invocation["shape_delivery"] == "application_args"
    return {
        "schema_version": 5,
        "device": "sm_86",
        "slug": schedule_cell["slug"],
        "shape_point": schedule_cell["shape_point"],
        "repeat_index": 0,
        "launch_index": launch_index,
        "binary_sha256": schedule_cell["binary_sha256"],
        "profiler_family": "nsight_compute",
        "profiler_version": "2026.1.0",
        "cuda_version": "13.2",
        "driver_version": "610.43.02",
        "gpu_uuid_sha256": "1" * 64,
        "replay_mode": "kernel",
        "aggregation": "kernel",
        "warmup_count": invocation["capture_launch_contract"][
            "label_driver_warmup_count"
        ],
        "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector": 0.5,
        "confidence_interval_l2_sector": {
            "lower": 0.5,
            "upper": 0.5,
            "confidence_level": 0.95,
            "units": "sector_hit_rate_fraction",
            "aggregation": "kernel",
        },
        "cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector": 0.5,
        "confidence_interval_l1tex_sector": {
            "lower": 0.5,
            "upper": 0.5,
            "confidence_level": 0.95,
            "units": "sector_hit_rate_fraction",
            "aggregation": "kernel",
        },
        "unit_tagged_metrics": [
            {
                "ncu_metric": metric,
                "unit": units[metric],
                "value": 0.5 if units[metric] == "pct" else 1.0,
            }
            for metric in matrix["metric_registry"]["collection"][
                "selected_unit_metrics"
            ]
        ],
        "measurement_protocol": {
            "ncu_clock_control": "none",
            "ncu_cache_control": "all",
            "ncu_replay_mode": "kernel",
            "ncu_target_processes": "all",
            "ncu_filter_mode": "global",
            "ncu_profile_from_start": profile_from_start,
            "ncu_launch_skip": launch_index,
            "ncu_launch_count": 1,
            "host_persistence_mode": "Enabled",
            "host_sm_clock_mhz": 1350,
            "host_mem_clock_mhz": 10501,
            "host_temperature_c": 61,
        },
    }


def _fake_m4_archive(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> tuple[dict, Path]:
    matrix = json.loads(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_text())
    original_git_blob = campaign._git_blob_bytes

    def fixture_git_blob(repo_root, source_commit, relative_path, *, role):
        if relative_path == campaign.SIDECAR_SCHEMA_PATH.relative_to(
            campaign.REPO_ROOT
        ).as_posix():
            return campaign.SIDECAR_SCHEMA_PATH.read_bytes()
        return original_git_blob(
            repo_root, source_commit, relative_path, role=role,
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign, "_git_blob_bytes", fixture_git_blob)
    matrix_cells = {
        (
            cell["identity"]["roster_source"],
            cell["identity"]["slug"],
        ): cell
        for cell in matrix["cells"]
    }
    schedule_cells = {cell["cell_id"]: cell for cell in schedule["cells"]}
    root = tmp_path / "m4"
    (root / "chunks").mkdir(parents=True)
    for chunk in matrix["chunks"]:
        chunk_root = root / "chunks" / chunk["chunk_id"]
        chunk_root.mkdir()
        rows = []
        for member in chunk["cells"]:
            source = member["roster_source"]
            slug = member["slug"]
            cell_id = f"{source}:{slug}"
            matrix_cell = matrix_cells[(source, slug)]
            schedule_cell = schedule_cells[cell_id]
            cell_root = chunk_root / "cells" / f"{source}__{slug}"
            cell_root.mkdir(parents=True)
            sidecar_path = cell_root / "label.json"
            run_path = cell_root / "run.json"
            report_path = cell_root / "report.ncu-rep"
            observation_path = cell_root / "launch.json"
            capture_path = cell_root / "capture.json"
            sidecar = _m4_sidecar(matrix, matrix_cell, schedule_cell)
            launch_index = sidecar["launch_index"]
            controls, _profile_from_start, shape_binding = (
                campaign._m4_expected_controls(matrix_cell, launch_index)
            )
            _write_json(sidecar_path, sidecar)
            signature = campaign.sha256_bytes(
                f"{slug}|{matrix_cell['invocation']['executable_path']}".encode()
            )
            run = {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "source_commit": matrix["source_commit"],
                "binary_sha256": schedule_cell["binary_sha256"],
                "kernel_signature_sha256": signature,
                "kernel_signature_source": "fallback_legacy",
                "arch": "sm_86",
                "slug": slug,
                "shape_point": str(
                    matrix_cell["invocation"]["logical_workload"]["value"]
                ),
                "repeat_index": 0,
                "launch_index": launch_index,
                "ncu_controls": controls,
            }
            _write_json(run_path, run)
            report_path.write_bytes(f"report:{cell_id}".encode())
            identity_columns = [
                "ID", "Device", "Kernel Name", "Block Size", "Grid Size",
            ]
            observation = {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "kind": "ncu_details_csv_launch_observation",
                "kernel_name_base": "mangled",
                "requested_launch_skip": launch_index,
                "requested_launch_count": 1,
                "report_sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(
                    report_path.read_bytes()
                ),
                "identity_columns": identity_columns,
                "identity": {
                    "ID": str(launch_index),
                    "Device": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti (0)",
                    "Kernel Name": f"_Z_fixture_{slug}",
                    "Block Size": "(128, 1, 1)",
                    "Grid Size": "(1, 1, 1)",
                },
            }
            observation["observation_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
                observation
            )
            _write_json(observation_path, observation)
            artifact_records = {
                "label_sidecar": _artifact(
                    sidecar_path, chunk_root, "label_sidecar"
                ),
                "label_run_manifest": _artifact(
                    run_path, chunk_root, "label_run_manifest"
                ),
                "ncu_report": _artifact(
                    report_path, chunk_root, "ncu_report"
                ),
                "ncu_launch_observation": _artifact(
                    observation_path, chunk_root, "ncu_launch_observation"
                ),
            }
            registry_payload = campaign._git_blob_bytes(
                campaign.REPO_ROOT,
                matrix["source_commit"],
                campaign.REGISTRY_PATH.relative_to(
                    campaign.REPO_ROOT
                ).as_posix(),
                role="fixture source registry",
            )
            capture = {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "identity": matrix_cell["identity"],
                "command": ["fixture-label-driver"],
                "binary_sha256": schedule_cell["binary_sha256"],
                "source_commit": matrix["source_commit"],
                "kernel_signature_sha256": signature,
                "kernel_signature_source": "fallback_legacy",
                "validated_artifact_receipt": {
                    "label_sidecar": {
                        "sha256": artifact_records["label_sidecar"]["sha256"],
                        "size_bytes": artifact_records["label_sidecar"][
                            "size_bytes"
                        ],
                    },
                    "label_run_manifest": {
                        "sha256": artifact_records["label_run_manifest"][
                            "sha256"
                        ],
                        "size_bytes": artifact_records["label_run_manifest"][
                            "size_bytes"
                        ],
                    },
                    "ncu_report": {
                        "sha256": artifact_records["ncu_report"]["sha256"],
                        "size_bytes": artifact_records["ncu_report"][
                            "size_bytes"
                        ],
                    },
                    "ncu_launch_observation": {
                        "sha256": artifact_records[
                            "ncu_launch_observation"
                        ]["sha256"],
                        "size_bytes": artifact_records[
                            "ncu_launch_observation"
                        ]["size_bytes"],
                        "observation_sha256": observation[
                            "observation_sha256"
                        ],
                    },
                    "metric_registry": {
                        "sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(registry_payload),
                        "size_bytes": len(registry_payload),
                    },
                },
                "selected_unit_metrics": matrix["metric_registry"][
                    "collection"
                ]["selected_unit_metrics"],
                "selected_flat_metrics": matrix["metric_registry"][
                    "collection"
                ]["selected_flat_metrics"],
                "toolchain_contract": {
                    "expected_cuda_release": {"major": 13, "minor": 2},
                    "observed_cuda_release": {"major": 13, "minor": 2},
                    "expected_ncu_version_prefix": "2026.1",
                    "observed_ncu_version": "2026.1.0",
                },
                "publication_metric_scope": None,
                "logical_workload_sha256": campaign.canonical_sha256(
                    matrix_cell["invocation"]["logical_workload"]
                ),
                "capture_launch_contract": matrix_cell["invocation"][
                    "capture_launch_contract"
                ],
                "requested_launch_index": launch_index,
                "ncu_controls": controls,
                "shape_binding": shape_binding,
                "shape_forwarded_to_target": (
                    shape_binding == "application-args"
                ),
                "sol_phase_evidence": None,
                "elapsed_seconds": 1.0,
            }
            _write_json(capture_path, capture)
            artifact_records["label_capture_manifest"] = _artifact(
                capture_path, chunk_root, "label_capture_manifest"
            )
            rows.append({
                "roster_source": source,
                "slug": slug,
                "authority_cell_sha256": matrix_cell["authority_cell_sha256"],
                "disposition": "admitted",
                "typed_reason": None,
                "artifacts": list(artifact_records.values()),
            })
        done = {
            "schema_version": 2,
            "manifest_kind": "campaign_chunk_done",
            "chunk_id": chunk["chunk_id"],
            "output_root": str(chunk_root),
            "source_commit_pre": matrix["source_commit"],
            "source_commit_post": matrix["source_commit"],
            "source_head_at_seal": matrix["source_commit"],
            "source_commit_stable": True,
            "working_tree_clean": True,
            "protocol_version": "2.1",
            "arch": "sm_86",
            "capture_matrix_sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(
                campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes()
            ),
            "matrix_seal_sha256": matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
            "roster_authority_sha256": matrix["authority"]["sha256"],
            "chunk_membership_sha256": chunk["membership_sha256"],
            "expected_cells": len(rows),
            "preflight_sha256": "e" * 64,
            "cell_results": rows,
        }
        _write_json(chunk_root / "DONE.json", done)
    _make_tree_readonly(root)

    def verified_done(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        assert len(args) == 1
        assert kwargs == {
            "repo_root": campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            "rehash_references": True,
            "require_current_head": True,
            "require_clean_tree": True,
        }
        return []

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.m4_done, "verify_seal", verified_done)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        campaign.matrix_builder, "validate_matrix", lambda *args, **kwargs: []
    )
    return matrix, root


def _schedule_with_complete_m4(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> tuple[dict, Path, dict]:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    receipt = campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
        archive_root=root,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    complete = copy.deepcopy(schedule)
    complete["m4_identity"] = receipt
    complete["schedule_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(complete, "schedule_sha256")
    )
    campaign.validate_schedule(complete)
    return matrix, root, complete


def _repeat_evidence_bundle(
    schedule: dict,
    slot: dict,
    journal_dir: Path,
    *,
    kernel_name: str | None = None,
    kernel_signature_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Path], dict]:
    journal_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    cell = next(item for item in schedule["cells"] if item["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"])
    config = next(
        item for item in schedule["configs"] if item["config_id"] == slot["config_id"]
    )
    m4_cell = next(
        item
        for item in schedule["m4_identity"]["cell_launch_identities"]
        if item["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"]
    )
    assert len(m4_cell["launches"]) == 1
    m4_launch = m4_cell["launches"][0]
    launch_index = m4_launch["launch_index"]
    observed_kernel = kernel_name or m4_launch["kernel_name"]
    observed_signature = (
        kernel_signature_sha256 or m4_launch["kernel_signature_sha256"]
    )
    signature_source = m4_launch["kernel_signature_source"]

    sidecar_path = journal_dir / "repeat_label.json"
    run_path = journal_dir / "repeat_run.json"
    report_path = journal_dir / "repeat_report.ncu-rep"
    observation_path = journal_dir / "repeat_launch.json"
    capture_path = journal_dir / "repeat_capture.json"

    sidecar = _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot)
    sidecar["launch_index"] = launch_index
    sidecar["measurement_protocol"]["ncu_launch_skip"] = launch_index
    _write_json(sidecar_path, sidecar)
    controls = campaign._m6_repeat_controls(config, launch_index)
    run = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "source_commit": schedule["source_identity"]["matrix_source_commit"],
        "binary_sha256": cell["binary_sha256"],
        "kernel_signature_sha256": observed_signature,
        "kernel_signature_source": signature_source,
        "arch": "sm_86",
        "slug": cell["slug"],
        "shape_point": cell["shape_point"],
        "repeat_index": slot["repeat_index"],
        "launch_index": launch_index,
        "ncu_controls": controls,
    }
    _write_json(run_path, run)
    report_path.write_bytes(f"repeat-report:{slot['slot_id']}".encode())
    identity_columns = [
        "ID", "Device", "Kernel Name", "Block Size", "Grid Size",
    ]
    observation = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "kind": "ncu_details_csv_launch_observation",
        "kernel_name_base": "mangled",
        "requested_launch_skip": launch_index,
        "requested_launch_count": 1,
        "report_sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(report_path.read_bytes()),
        "identity_columns": identity_columns,
        "identity": {
            "ID": str(launch_index),
            "Device": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti (0)",
            "Kernel Name": observed_kernel,
            "Block Size": "(128, 1, 1)",
            "Grid Size": "(1, 1, 1)",
        },
    }
    observation["observation_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(observation)
    _write_json(observation_path, observation)

    def receipt(path: Path) -> dict:
        payload = path.read_bytes()
        return {
            "sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(payload),
            "size_bytes": len(payload),
        }

    artifact_receipt = {
        "label_sidecar": receipt(sidecar_path),
        "label_run_manifest": receipt(run_path),
        "ncu_report": receipt(report_path),
        "ncu_launch_observation": {
            **receipt(observation_path),
            "observation_sha256": observation["observation_sha256"],
        },
    }
    capture = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "artifact_kind": "m6_repeat_capture_manifest",
        "source_commit": schedule["source_identity"]["matrix_source_commit"],
        "schedule_sha256": schedule["schedule_sha256"],
        "slot_id": slot["slot_id"],
        "slot_sha256": slot["slot_sha256"],
        "cell_id": cell["cell_id"],
        "cell_identity_sha256": cell["cell_identity_sha256"],
        "config_id": config["config_id"],
        "config_sha256": config["config_sha256"],
        "repeat_index": slot["repeat_index"],
        "launch_index": launch_index,
        "binary_sha256": cell["binary_sha256"],
        "kernel_name": observed_kernel,
        "kernel_signature_sha256": observed_signature,
        "kernel_signature_source": signature_source,
        "ncu_controls": controls,
        "validated_artifact_receipt": artifact_receipt,
    }
    capture["capture_manifest_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(capture)
    _write_json(capture_path, capture)
    return sidecar_path, {
        "label_run_manifest": run_path,
        "ncu_report": report_path,
        "ncu_launch_observation": observation_path,
        "label_capture_manifest": capture_path,
    }, m4_launch


def test_complete_m4_receipt_is_rederived_from_verified_done_artifacts(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    receipt = campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
        archive_root=root,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    assert len(receipt["chunk_done_manifests"]) == 18
    assert len(receipt["cell_launch_identities"]) == 122
    assert receipt["preflight_sha256s"] == ["e" * 64]
    campaign._validate_m4_identity(
        receipt,
        matrix=matrix,
        matrix_sha256=campaign.sha256_bytes(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes()),
        cells=schedule["cells"],
        repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
        require_complete=True,
    )

    fake = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
    fake_launch = fake["cell_launch_identities"][0]["launches"][0]
    fake_launch["kernel_name"] += "_fake"
    fake_launch["launch_identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(fake_launch, "launch_identity_sha256")
    )
    fake["cell_launch_identities"][0]["launch_set_sha256"] = (
        campaign.canonical_sha256(
            fake["cell_launch_identities"][0]["launches"]
        )
    )
    fake["identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(fake, "identity_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign._validate_m4_identity(
            fake,
            matrix=matrix,
            matrix_sha256=campaign.sha256_bytes(
                campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes()
            ),
            cells=schedule["cells"],
            repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            require_complete=True,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_M4_RECEIPT_REDERIVATION"


def test_bind_m4_refuses_authoritative_done_verifier_failure(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    _matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        campaign.m4_done,
        "verify_seal",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: ["forged DONE"],
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_M4_DONE_UNVERIFIED"


def test_m4_binding_rejects_cross_generation_tree(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    _matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    sentinel = root / "unreferenced-evidence.bin"
    root.chmod(0o755)
    sentinel.write_bytes(b"before")
    sentinel.chmod(0o444)
    root.chmod(0o555)
    mutated = False

    def mutate_tree(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        nonlocal mutated
        if not mutated:
            mutated = True
            sentinel.chmod(0o644)
            sentinel.write_bytes(b"after!")
            sentinel.chmod(0o444)
        return []

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.m4_done, "verify_seal", mutate_tree)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_TREE_CHANGED"


def test_bind_m4_refuses_cross_root_done_and_no_overwrite(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    chunk_id = matrix["chunks"][0]["chunk_id"]
    done_path = root / "chunks" / chunk_id / "DONE.json"
    done = json.loads(done_path.read_text())
    done["output_root"] = str(tmp_path / "different-root")
    done_path.chmod(0o644)
    _write_json(done_path, done)
    done_path.chmod(0o444)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_M4_DONE_BINDING"

    _matrix, second_root = _fake_m4_archive(
        schedule, tmp_path / "second", monkeypatch,
    )
    out = tmp_path / "receipt.json"
    assert campaign.main([
        "bind-m4", "--m4-root", str(second_root),
        "--generated-at-utc", FIXED_TIME, "--out", str(out),
    ]) == 0
    before = out.read_bytes()
    assert campaign.main([
        "bind-m4", "--m4-root", str(second_root),
        "--generated-at-utc", FIXED_TIME, "--out", str(out),
    ]) == 2
    assert out.read_bytes() == before


def test_m4_binding_refuses_authority_overlap_partial_and_missing_capture(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    receipt = campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
        archive_root=root,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    writable_done = root / "chunks" / matrix["chunks"][0]["chunk_id"] / "DONE.json"
    writable_done.chmod(0o644)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as writable_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert writable_error.value.code == "M6_TREE_SNAPSHOT"
    writable_done.chmod(0o444)
    matrix_sha256 = campaign.sha256_bytes(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes())

    incomplete = copy.deepcopy(schedule["m4_identity"])
    incomplete["completed_cells"] = 121
    incomplete["identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(incomplete, "identity_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as incomplete_error:
        campaign._validate_m4_identity(
            incomplete,
            matrix=matrix,
            matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
            cells=schedule["cells"],
            repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            require_complete=False,
        )
    assert incomplete_error.value.code == "M6_M4_INCOMPLETE_IDENTITY"

    partial = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
    partial["completed_cells"] = 121
    partial["cell_launch_identities"].pop()
    partial["identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(partial, "identity_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as partial_error:
        campaign._validate_m4_identity(
            partial,
            matrix=matrix,
            matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
            cells=schedule["cells"],
            repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            require_complete=True,
        )
    assert partial_error.value.code == "M6_SCHEMA_VALIDATION"

    for output in (
        root / "overlapping-receipt.json",
        campaign.REPO_ROOT / ".m6-overlapping-receipt-test.json",
    ):
        assert not output.exists()
        with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as overlap_error:
            campaign._authorize_m4_receipt_output(
                output,
                archive_root=root,
                repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            )
        assert overlap_error.value.code == "M6_M4_RECEIPT_OUTPUT_OVERLAP"
        assert not output.exists()

    alternate_matrix = tmp_path / "alternate-matrix.json"
    alternate_matrix.write_bytes(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes())
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as matrix_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            matrix_path=alternate_matrix,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert matrix_error.value.code == "M6_SOURCE_AUTHORITY"

    alternate_repo = tmp_path / "alternate-repository"
    alternate_repo.mkdir()
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as repository_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            repo_root=alternate_repo,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert repository_error.value.code == "M6_REPOSITORY_AUTHORITY"

    chunk_id = matrix["chunks"][0]["chunk_id"]
    done_path = root / "chunks" / chunk_id / "DONE.json"
    done = json.loads(done_path.read_text())
    done["cell_results"][0]["artifacts"] = [
        artifact
        for artifact in done["cell_results"][0]["artifacts"]
        if artifact["artifact_kind"] != "label_capture_manifest"
    ]
    done_path.chmod(0o644)
    _write_json(done_path, done)
    done_path.chmod(0o444)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as capture_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert capture_error.value.code == "M6_M4_ARTIFACT_CARDINALITY"


def test_complete_m4_repeat_evidence_rejects_same_index_wrong_kernel(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    _matrix, _root, complete = _schedule_with_complete_m4(
        schedule, tmp_path / "archive", monkeypatch,
    )
    slot = complete["slots"][0]
    valid_dir = tmp_path / "valid-repeat"
    sidecar_path, evidence_paths, m4_launch = _repeat_evidence_bundle(
        complete, slot, valid_dir,
    )
    event = campaign.build_observed_event(
        complete,
        slot,
        [sidecar_path],
        journal_dir=valid_dir,
        observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
        launch_evidence_paths=[evidence_paths],
    )
    assert event["sidecars"][0]["m4_launch_identity_sha256"] == (
        m4_launch["launch_identity_sha256"]
    )
    assert event["sidecars"][0]["launch_evidence"]["kernel_name"] == (
        m4_launch["kernel_name"]
    )
    journal = campaign.build_journal(
        complete, [event], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    journal_path = valid_dir / "journal.json"
    _write_json(journal_path, journal)
    campaign.validate_journal(complete, journal, journal_path=journal_path)

    missing_capture = dict(evidence_paths)
    missing_capture.pop("label_capture_manifest")
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as missing_error:
        campaign.build_observed_event(
            complete,
            slot,
            [sidecar_path],
            journal_dir=valid_dir,
            observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
            ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
            launch_evidence_paths=[missing_capture],
        )
    assert missing_error.value.code == "M6_REPEAT_EVIDENCE_PATHS"

    wrong_dir = tmp_path / "wrong-kernel-repeat"
    wrong_sidecar, wrong_evidence, _ = _repeat_evidence_bundle(
        complete,
        slot,
        wrong_dir,
        kernel_name=f"{m4_launch['kernel_name']}_different_kernel",
        kernel_signature_sha256="f" * 64,
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as wrong_kernel_error:
        campaign.build_observed_event(
            complete,
            slot,
            [wrong_sidecar],
            journal_dir=wrong_dir,
            observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
            ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
            launch_evidence_paths=[wrong_evidence],
        )
    assert wrong_kernel_error.value.code == "M6_M4_KERNEL_IDENTITY"

def test_collect_is_unconditionally_disabled_after_prerequisite_gate(
    schedule: dict, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys
) -> None:
    schedule_path = tmp_path / "schedule.json"
    _write_json(schedule_path, schedule)
    original = campaign._validate_m4_identity

    def allow_complete(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        if kwargs.get("require_complete"):
            return None
        return original(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign, "_validate_m4_identity", allow_complete)
    assert campaign.main(["collect", "--schedule", str(schedule_path)]) == 2
    assert "M6_COLLECT_DISABLED_OFFLINE_SOURCE" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_external_v5_oor_value_is_retained_uncensored(schedule: dict, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    slot = next(slot for slot in schedule["slots"] if slot["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG)
    sidecar_path = tmp_path / "label.json"
    _write_json(sidecar_path, _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot, value=1.25))
    event = campaign.build_observed_event(
        schedule,
        slot,
        [sidecar_path],
        journal_dir=tmp_path,
        observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        ncu_replay_pass_count=3,
    )
    journal = campaign.build_journal(schedule, [event], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME)
    journal_path = tmp_path / "journal.json"
    _write_json(journal_path, journal)
    analysis = campaign.analyze(
        schedule,
        journal,
        journal_path=journal_path,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        bootstrap_replicates=10,
    )
    raw = next(
        row
        for row in analysis["row_accounting"]
        if row["metric_key"] == "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector"
        and row["value"] is not None
    )
    assert raw["value"] == 1.25
    assert raw["validity"] == "out_of_range_high"
    assert raw["typed_reason"] == "ncu_pct_overflow"
    classification = next(
        row
        for row in analysis["classifications"]
        if row["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"]
        and row["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG
        and row["metric_key"] == "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector"
    )
    assert classification["determinism_class"] == "vendor_defect"
    assert analysis["analysis_policy"]["raw_values_clamped"] is False
    decision = next(
        row for row in analysis["trigger_decisions"] if row["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"]
    )
    assert decision["triggered"] is True
    assert "out_of_range" in decision["reason_codes"]
    assert analysis["accounting"]["collected_identity_holds"] is True
    assert analysis["accounting"]["denominator_identity_holds"] is True

def test_journal_hash_chain_and_sidecar_immutability_are_verified(
    schedule: dict, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    slot = next(slot for slot in schedule["slots"] if slot["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG)
    sidecar_path = tmp_path / "label.json"
    _write_json(sidecar_path, _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot))
    event = campaign.build_observed_event(
        schedule,
        slot,
        [sidecar_path],
        journal_dir=tmp_path,
        observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
    )
    journal = campaign.build_journal(schedule, [event], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME)
    journal_path = tmp_path / "journal.json"
    _write_json(journal_path, journal)
    campaign.validate_journal(schedule, journal, journal_path=journal_path)

    tampered = copy.deepcopy(journal)
    tampered["events"][0]["raw_observations"][0]["value"] = 0.75
    tampered["events"][0]["event_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(tampered["events"][0], "event_sha256")
    )
    tampered["journal_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(tampered, "journal_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.validate_journal(schedule, tampered, journal_path=journal_path)
    assert error.value.code == "M6_RAW_OBSERVATION_MISMATCH"

    sidecar = json.loads(sidecar_path.read_text())
    sidecar["cache_hit_rate_l2_sector"] = 0.6
    _write_json(sidecar_path, sidecar)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as changed:
        campaign.validate_journal(schedule, journal, journal_path=journal_path)
    assert changed.value.code == "M6_SIDECAR_REFERENCE"

        "--journal", str(journal_path),

_EMPTY_SHA256 = immutable.sha256_bytes(b"")
_MAX_SAFE_JSON_INTEGER = (1 << 53) - 1
_RECEIPT_DOMAIN = b"M5_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT_V1\0"
_ED25519_Q = 2**255 - 19
_ED25519_L = 2**252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493
_ED25519_D = (-121665 * pow(121666, _ED25519_Q - 2, _ED25519_Q)) % _ED25519_Q
_ED25519_I = pow(2, (_ED25519_Q - 1) // 4, _ED25519_Q)


def _ed25519_xrecover(y: int) -> int:
    xx = (y * y - 1) * pow(_ED25519_D * y * y + 1, _ED25519_Q - 2, _ED25519_Q)
    x = pow(xx % _ED25519_Q, (_ED25519_Q + 3) // 8, _ED25519_Q)
    if (x * x - xx) % _ED25519_Q != 0:
        x = x * _ED25519_I % _ED25519_Q
    if (x * x - xx) % _ED25519_Q != 0:
        _fail("invalid Ed25519 point encoding")
    return x


def _ed25519_decode_point(encoded: bytes, label: str) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    if len(encoded) != 32:
        _fail(f"{label} must be exactly 32 bytes")
    raw = int.from_bytes(encoded, "little")
    sign = raw >> 255
    y = raw & ((1 << 255) - 1)
    if y >= _ED25519_Q:
        _fail(f"{label} is not a canonical Ed25519 point")
    x = _ed25519_xrecover(y)
    if x & 1 != sign:
        x = _ED25519_Q - x
    if (y * y - x * x - 1 - _ED25519_D * x * x * y * y) % _ED25519_Q:
        _fail(f"{label} is not on the Ed25519 curve")
    return x, y, 1, x * y % _ED25519_Q


def _ed25519_add(
    left: tuple[int, int, int, int], right: tuple[int, int, int, int]
) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    x1, y1, z1, t1 = left
    x2, y2, z2, t2 = right
    a = (y1 - x1) * (y2 - x2) % _ED25519_Q
    b = (y1 + x1) * (y2 + x2) % _ED25519_Q
    c = 2 * _ED25519_D * t1 * t2 % _ED25519_Q
    d = 2 * z1 * z2 % _ED25519_Q
    e = (b - a) % _ED25519_Q
    f = (d - c) % _ED25519_Q
    g = (d + c) % _ED25519_Q
    h = (b + a) % _ED25519_Q
    return e * f % _ED25519_Q, g * h % _ED25519_Q, f * g % _ED25519_Q, e * h % _ED25519_Q


def _ed25519_scalar_mult(
    point: tuple[int, int, int, int], scalar: int
) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    result = (0, 1, 1, 0)
    addend = point
    while scalar:
        if scalar & 1:
            result = _ed25519_add(result, addend)
        addend = _ed25519_add(addend, addend)
        scalar >>= 1
    return result


_ED25519_BASE = _ed25519_decode_point(
    bytes.fromhex("5866666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666666"),
    "Ed25519 base point",
)


def _ed25519_equal(
    left: tuple[int, int, int, int], right: tuple[int, int, int, int]
) -> bool:
    return (
        (left[0] * right[2] - right[0] * left[2]) % _ED25519_Q == 0
        and (left[1] * right[2] - right[1] * left[2]) % _ED25519_Q == 0
    )


def _verify_ed25519(public_key: bytes, message: bytes, signature: bytes) -> None:
    if len(signature) != 64:
        _fail("authority receipt signature must be exactly 64 bytes")
    public_point = _ed25519_decode_point(public_key, "authority public key")
    r_point = _ed25519_decode_point(signature[:32], "authority receipt R")
    scalar = int.from_bytes(signature[32:], "little")
    if scalar >= _ED25519_L:
        _fail("authority receipt signature scalar is noncanonical")
    identity = (0, 1, 1, 0)
    if _ed25519_equal(public_point, identity) or not _ed25519_equal(
        _ed25519_scalar_mult(public_point, _ED25519_L), identity
    ):
        _fail("authority public key is not in the prime-order subgroup")
    if _ed25519_equal(r_point, identity) or not _ed25519_equal(
        _ed25519_scalar_mult(r_point, _ED25519_L), identity
    ):
        _fail("authority receipt R is not in the prime-order subgroup")
    challenge = int.from_bytes(
        hashlib.sha512(signature[:32] + public_key + message).digest(), "little"
    ) % _ED25519_L
    if not _ed25519_equal(
        _ed25519_scalar_mult(_ED25519_BASE, scalar),
        _ed25519_add(r_point, _ed25519_scalar_mult(public_point, challenge)),
    ):
        _fail("authority receipt Ed25519 signature mismatch")


def _validate_ed25519_public_key(public_key: bytes, label: str) -> None:
    point = _ed25519_decode_point(public_key, label)
    identity = (0, 1, 1, 0)
    if _ed25519_equal(point, identity) or not _ed25519_equal(
        _ed25519_scalar_mult(point, _ED25519_L), identity
    ):
        _fail(f"{label} is not a nonidentity prime-order Ed25519 point")


def _quantity_row(
    quantity_id: str,
    quantity_group: str,
    family_id: str | None,
    consumer_binding: str,
    unit: str,
    meaning: str,
    access_class: str,
    gap_kinds: tuple[str, ...],
    methods: tuple[str, str],
    *,
    agreement_limit: float = 0.10,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    producer = (
        {"kind": "PROBE_FAMILY", "family_id": family_id}
        if family_id is not None
        else {"kind": "PCHASE", "component_id": "pchase"}
    )
    contracts = []
    role_sets = (("curve", "control"), ("confound", "composition"))
    for index, (method, roles) in enumerate(zip(methods, role_sets, strict=True), start=1):
        instrument = "THROUGHPUT" if method.startswith("THROUGHPUT") or method in {
            "BURST_SLOPE_BREAK",
            "LITTLE_LAW_TRIANGULATION",
        } else "CLOCK64"
        readout_id = f"{quantity_id}.r{index}"
        contracts.append(
            {
                "readout_id": readout_id,
                "method_class": method,
                "instrument": instrument,
                "readout_role": "VALUE",
                "derivation_identity_id": f"{readout_id}.derivation",
                "derivation_operation": "MEDIAN",
                "sample_operation": "RATIO",
                "required_evidence_roles": list(roles),
            }
        )
    if unit == "probability":
        value_domain = {"kind": "PROBABILITY", "integral": False}
    elif unit == "structure":
        value_domain = {"kind": "NONNEGATIVE", "integral": False}
    else:
        integral_units = {"bytes", "sectors", "lines", "ways", "entries"}
        value_domain = {"kind": "POSITIVE", "integral": unit in integral_units}
    return {
        "quantity_id": quantity_id,
        "quantity_group": quantity_group,
        "producer": producer,
        "consumer_binding": consumer_binding,
        "meaning": meaning,
        "conditioning": {
            "residency": "NOT_APPLICABLE" if family_id is None else "MIXED",
            "access_class": access_class,
            "scope": "sm_86",
            "variant": quantity_id,
        },
        "unit": unit,
        "value_domain": value_domain,
        "agreement_limit_fraction": agreement_limit,
        "readout_contracts": contracts,
        "authorized_gap_kinds": list(gap_kinds),
        "required": True,
    }

def _strict_integer(_checker: Any, instance: Any) -> bool:
    return type(instance) is int and abs(instance) <= _MAX_SAFE_JSON_INTEGER


def _strict_number(_checker: Any, instance: Any) -> bool:
    return (
        type(instance) is int
        and abs(instance) <= _MAX_SAFE_JSON_INTEGER
    ) or (type(instance) is float and math.isfinite(instance))


_STRICT_TYPE_CHECKER = (
    jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.TYPE_CHECKER.redefine("integer", _strict_integer).redefine(
        "number", _strict_number
    )
)
StrictDraft202012Validator = validators.extend(
    jsonschema.Draft202012Validator, type_checker=_STRICT_TYPE_CHECKER
)


class M5ContractError(RuntimeError):
    """A versioned M5 contract, policy, or immutable-byte check failed."""


def _fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise M5ContractError(message)


def _contract_boundary(function: Callable[..., Any]) -> Callable[..., Any]:
    """Convert malformed external structure and filesystem failures to one typed refusal."""

    @functools.wraps(function)
    def guarded(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        try:
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        except M5ContractError:
            raise
        except immutable.ImmutableArtifactError as exc:
            raise M5ContractError(str(exc)) from exc
        except (KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, ValueError, OverflowError, OSError) as exc:
            raise M5ContractError(f"malformed or inaccessible M5 contract: {exc}") from exc

    return guarded


def _exact_object(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if type(value) is not dict:
        _fail(f"{label} must be an exact JSON object")
    return value


def _exact_array(value: Any, label: str) -> list[Any]:
    if type(value) is not list:
        _fail(f"{label} must be an exact JSON array")
    return value


def _exact_string(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str:
        _fail(f"{label} must be an exact JSON string")
    return value


def _exact_int(value: Any, label: str) -> int:
    if type(value) is not int or abs(value) > _MAX_SAFE_JSON_INTEGER:
        _fail(f"{label} must be an exact safe-range JSON integer")
    return value


def _exact_bool(value: Any, label: str) -> bool:
    if type(value) is not bool:
        _fail(f"{label} must be an exact JSON boolean")
    return value


def _require_keys(value: Mapping[str, Any], required: Iterable[str], label: str) -> None:
    expected = set(required)
    observed = set(value)
    if observed != expected:
        _fail(
            f"{label} keys mismatch: missing={sorted(expected - observed)}, "
            f"extra={sorted(observed - expected)}"
        )


def _safe_id(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
    text = _exact_string(value, label)
    if _SAFE_ID.fullmatch(text) is None:
        _fail(f"{label} is not a safe identifier")
    return text


def _schema_from_bytes(payload: bytes, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        schema = immutable.strict_json_loads(payload, label=label)
    except immutable.ImmutableArtifactError as exc:
        _fail(str(exc))
    schema = _exact_object(schema, label)
    if schema.get("$schema") != "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema":
        _fail(f"{label} is not Draft-2020-12")

    def reject_external_references(node: Any) -> None:
        if type(node) is dict:
            for key, value in node.items():
                if key in {"$ref", "$dynamicRef"} and (
                    type(value) is not str or not value.startswith("#")
                ):
                    _fail(f"{label} contains a non-bundled schema reference")
                reject_external_references(value)
        elif type(node) is list:
            for value in node:
                reject_external_references(value)

    reject_external_references(schema)
    try:
        jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
    except jsonschema.SchemaError as exc:
        _fail(f"invalid schema authority {label}: {exc.message}")
    return schema


def _live_schema(kind: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = SCHEMA_PATHS.get(kind)
    if path is None:
        _fail(f"unsupported explicit schema dispatch: {kind}")
    try:
        payload = immutable.read_regular(path)
    except immutable.ImmutableArtifactError as exc:
        _fail(str(exc))
    if immutable.sha256_bytes(payload) != SCHEMA_SHA256_V1[kind]:
        _fail(f"live {kind} schema digest is not controller-pinned v1")
    schema = _schema_from_bytes(payload, path.name)
    if schema.get("$id") != SCHEMA_IDS[kind]:
        _fail(f"live {kind} schema has the wrong explicit schema identifier")
    return schema
