            "inventory_sha256": entry["inventory_sha256"],
        })
    # Close the newly appended row and all historical rows before success.
    load_preparation_failure_ledger(ledger_path, verify_archives=True)
    return entry


def _current_head_clean() -> tuple[str, bool]:
    head = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO_ROOT,
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
    )
    status = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"], cwd=REPO_ROOT,
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
    )
    return head.stdout.strip(), head.returncode == 0 and status.returncode == 0 and not status.stdout


def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--archive-preparation-failure", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--build-reconstructed-context", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--context-mode",
        choices=(CONTEXT_MODE_CONTEMPORANEOUS, CONTEXT_MODE_RECONSTRUCTED),
        default=CONTEXT_MODE_CONTEMPORANEOUS,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--journals-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--preparation-failures-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--original-matrix", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--chunk-run-journal", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--runner-refusal-record", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--phase-log", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--gpu-process-observation", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--replacement-head", required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--rlcr-dir", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_RLCR_DIR,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--adjudication-ref", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_STAGE_EQUIVALENCE_ADJUDICATION,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--stage-equivalence-adjudication-source", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_STAGE_EQUIVALENCE_SOURCE,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--problem-packager-source", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_PROBLEM_PACKAGER_SOURCE,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--reconstruction-root", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_RECONSTRUCTION_ROOT,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--session-log", type=Path, default=ROUND28_SESSION_LOG,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--corrected-adjudication-ref", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_CORRECTED_ADJUDICATION,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--superseded-adjudication-ref", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_SUPERSEDED_ADJUDICATION,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--correction-adjudication-ref", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_CORRECTION_ADJUDICATION,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--correction2-adjudication-ref", type=Path,
        default=ROUND28_CORRECTION2_ADJUDICATION,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--override-preparation-attempt-limit", action="store_true")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = _parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if (
        args.archive_preparation_failure == args.build_reconstructed_context
    ):
        print(
            "archive_preparation_failure: REFUSED "
            "[PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_FLAG_REQUIRED] "
            "choose exactly one explicit build/archive action",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1
    if (
        args.journals_root.resolve() != ROUND28_JOURNALS_ROOT
        or args.preparation_failures_root.resolve()
        != ROUND28_PREPARATION_FAILURES_ROOT
    ):
        print(
            "archive_preparation_failure: REFUSED "
            "[PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_MISSING] "
            "the Round-28 archival CLI requires the adjudicated fixed source "
            "and preparation-failure roots",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1
    if args.context_mode != CONTEXT_MODE_RECONSTRUCTED:
        head, clean = _current_head_clean()
        if head != args.replacement_head or not clean:
            print(
                "archive_preparation_failure: REFUSED "
                "[PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_MISSING] "
                f"replacement HEAD/clean-tree mismatch: head={head} clean={clean}",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
    request = ArchiveRequest(
        journals_root=args.journals_root,
        preparation_failures_root=args.preparation_failures_root,
        original_matrix_path=args.original_matrix,
        chunk_run_journal=args.chunk_run_journal,
        runner_refusal_record=args.runner_refusal_record,
        phase_log=args.phase_log,
        gpu_process_observation=args.gpu_process_observation,
        adjudication_ref=args.adjudication_ref,
        rlcr_dir=args.rlcr_dir,
        replacement_head=args.replacement_head,
        problem_packager_source=args.problem_packager_source,
        override_preparation_attempt_limit=args.override_preparation_attempt_limit,
        context_mode=args.context_mode,
        reconstruction_root=args.reconstruction_root,
        session_log_path=args.session_log,
        corrected_adjudication_ref=args.corrected_adjudication_ref,
        superseded_adjudication_ref=args.superseded_adjudication_ref,
        correction_adjudication_ref=args.correction_adjudication_ref,
        correction2_adjudication_ref=args.correction2_adjudication_ref,
        stage_equivalence_adjudication_source=(
            args.stage_equivalence_adjudication_source
        ),
    )
    campaign_lock = None
    try:
        campaign_lock = _acquire_campaign_lock(ROUND28_CAMPAIGN_ROOT)
        if args.build_reconstructed_context:
            if args.context_mode != CONTEXT_MODE_RECONSTRUCTED:
                raise PreparationArchiveRefusal(
                    "SOL_PREP_RECON_ALLOWLIST_VIOLATION",
                    "the builder requires --context-mode reconstructed",
                )
            entry = build_reconstructed_context(request)
        else:
            entry = archive_preparation_failure(request)
    except PreparationArchiveRefusal as exc:
        print(
            f"archive_preparation_failure: REFUSED [{exc.code}] {exc.detail}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1
    except (OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(
            "archive_preparation_failure: REFUSED "
            f"[PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_MISSING] {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1
    finally:
        if campaign_lock is not None:
            campaign_lock.close()
    print(json.dumps(entry, sort_keys=True))
    return 0

def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], cwd=repo, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False,
    )
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
    return proc.stdout.strip()


def _commit(repo: Path, subject: str) -> str:
    _git(repo, "add", "-A")
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "git", "-c", "user.name=Round28 Fixture",
            "-c", "user.email=round28-fixture@example.invalid",
            "commit", "-m", subject,
        ],
        cwd=repo, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True,
    )
    return _git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")


def _jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        "".join(
            json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
            for row in rows
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


class _ReconstructedFixture:
    def __init__(
        self, *, request: ap.ArchiveRequest, repo: Path,
        h2: str, h3: str, journal: Path, legacy_blob: bytes,
        adjudication_hashes: dict[str, str],
    ) -> None:
        self.request = request
        self.repo = repo
        self.h2 = h2
        self.h3 = h3
        self.journal = journal
        self.legacy_blob = legacy_blob
        self.adjudication_hashes = adjudication_hashes


def test_checked_in_v1_alias_chain_fails_closed_without_named_adr() -> None:
    value = json.loads(ap.ROUND28_PATH_ALIASES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    adr = ap.REPO_ROOT / ap.ROUND28_PATH_ALIAS_ADR_RELATIVE
    assert not adr.exists()

    with pytest.raises(ap.PreparationArchiveRefusal) as caught:
        ap._validated_path_alias_rows(value)
    assert caught.value.code == "PREP_ARCHIVE_EVIDENCE_ALIAS_AUTHORITY_MISSING"

def test_repository_adjudications_accept_tracked_clean_0644(
    repository_adjudications,
) -> None:
    _, request, paths, _ = repository_adjudications
    assert all(path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o644 for path in paths.values())
    assert ap._adjudication_hashes(request)["stage_equivalence"] == _sha(
        paths["stage_equivalence"]
    )

def _assert_refusal(code: str, function, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ap.PreparationArchiveRefusal) as caught:
        function(*args, **kwargs)
    assert caught.value.code == code

    ]


def _tree_snapshot(root: Path) -> list[tuple[str, str, int, str | None]]:
    if not root.exists():
        return []
    rows: list[tuple[str, str, int, str | None]] = []
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"), key=lambda item: item.as_posix()):
        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        if path.is_file():
            rows.append((relative, "file", path.stat().st_mode, _sha(path)))
        elif path.is_dir():
            rows.append((relative, "directory", path.stat().st_mode, None))
        else:
            rows.append((relative, "other", path.lstat().st_mode, None))
    return rows


def _install_post_move_inventory_drift(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    renamed = False
    original_rename = ap._rename_noreplace
    original_inventory = ap.content_inventory

    def tracked_rename(source, destination):
        nonlocal renamed
        original_rename(source, destination)
        renamed = True

    def post_move_drift(root):
        rows = original_inventory(root)
        if renamed:
            rows[0] = {**rows[0], "sha256": "0" * 64}
        return rows

    monkeypatch.setattr(ap, "_rename_noreplace", tracked_rename)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ap, "content_inventory", post_move_drift)


def test_reconstructed_builder_sandwich_external_source_and_seven_log_events(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    before = ap.content_inventory(fixture.journal)
    records = ap.build_reconstructed_context(fixture.request)

    assert list(records) == list(ap.ROUND28_RECONSTRUCTION_RECORD_ORDER)
    root = fixture.request.reconstruction_root
    source = root / "scratch/source_definition.json"
    staged = root / "scratch/staged_definition.json"
    assert _sha(source) == ap.ROUND28_PINNED_SOURCE_DEFINITION_SHA256
    assert _sha(staged) == ap.ROUND28_STAGED_DEFINITION_SHA256
    assert source.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o444
    assert staged.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o444
    assert ap.content_inventory(fixture.journal) == before

    reproduction = records["legacy_comparator_reproduction.json"]
    assert reproduction["tool"]["head"] == fixture.h3
    assert reproduction["verdict"] == {
        "equal": False,
        "differing_top_level_keys": ["op_type"],
        "difference_pointers": ["/op_type"],
        "maps_to_refusal_code": "sol_stage_source_mismatch",
    }
    assert reproduction["inputs"]["source_origin"] == {
        "kind": "external_prepare_manifest_pinned",
        "prepare_manifest_journal_relative_path": (
            ap.ROUND28_MANIFEST_JOURNAL_RELATIVE_PATH
        ),
        "prepare_manifest_sha256": ap.ROUND28_PREPARE_MANIFEST_SHA256,
        "source_path": str(ap.ROUND28_SOURCE_DEFINITION_PATH),
    }
    assert reproduction["inputs"]["staged_origin"] == {
        "kind": "historical_journal_member",
        "journal_relative_path": (
            ap.ROUND28_STAGED_DEFINITION_JOURNAL_RELATIVE_PATH
        ),
    }
    assert len(reproduction["command_argv"]) == 13
    assert reproduction["command_argv"][10] == fixture.h3

    rows = ap._load_session_log(fixture.request.session_log_path)
    record_rows = [
        row for row in rows if row.get("event") == "reconstruction_record_created"
    ]
    assert [Path(row["artifact"]).name for row in record_rows] == [
        "legacy_comparator_source_excerpt.py.txt",
        "legacy_comparator_reproduction.json",
        "runner_refusal_reconstruction.json",
        "phase_reconstruction.json",
        "gpu_process_observation_late.raw.txt",
        "gpu_process_observation_late.json",
        "preparation_failure_no_gpu_attestation_v2.json",
    ]
    assert len(record_rows) == 7
    for name, record in records.items():
        schema = json.loads(ap.RECONSTRUCTION_RECORD_SCHEMAS[name].read_text())
        jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(record)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("mutation", "expected_code"),
    [
        ("manifest_hash", "SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_INPUT_DRIFT"),
        ("external_source_missing", "SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_INPUT_DRIFT"),
        ("journal_complete", "PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_NOT_PREGPU"),
    ],
)
def test_reconstructed_builder_refuses_input_and_completion_drift_before_tool(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    mutation: str,
    expected_code: str,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    if mutation == "manifest_hash":
        manifest = (
            fixture.journal / ap.ROUND28_MANIFEST_JOURNAL_RELATIVE_PATH
        )
        manifest.write_bytes(manifest.read_bytes() + b" ")
    elif mutation == "external_source_missing":
        monkeypatch.setattr(
            ap, "ROUND28_SOURCE_DEFINITION_PATH",
            fixture.repo / "does-not-exist.json",
        )
    else:
        (fixture.journal / "journal_complete.json").write_text("{}\n")

    _assert_refusal(expected_code, ap.build_reconstructed_context, fixture.request)
    assert not (
        fixture.request.reconstruction_root / "legacy_comparator_reproduction.json"
    ).exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "action",
    [ap.build_reconstructed_context, ap.archive_preparation_failure],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "field", ["adjudication_ref", "problem_packager_source"],
)
def test_reconstructed_allowlist_pins_context_source_paths_before_mutation(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
    action,
    field: str,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    replacement = fixture.request.rlcr_dir / f"wrong-{field}.txt"
    replacement.write_text("wrong reconstructed input\n", encoding="utf-8")
    request = replace(fixture.request, **{field: replacement})
    journal_before = _tree_snapshot(fixture.request.journals_root)
    preparation_before = _tree_snapshot(
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
    )

    _assert_refusal(
        "SOL_PREP_RECON_ALLOWLIST_VIOLATION", action, request,
    )

    assert _tree_snapshot(fixture.request.journals_root) == journal_before
    assert _tree_snapshot(
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
    ) == preparation_before
    assert not fixture.request.reconstruction_root.exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("drift", ["dirty", "head", "parent", "subject"])
def test_h3_builder_identity_failures_are_typed(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    drift: str,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    request = fixture.request
    if drift == "dirty":
        (fixture.repo / "dirty.txt").write_text("dirty\n")
    elif drift == "head":
        request = replace(request, replacement_head="f" * 40)
    elif drift == "parent":
        monkeypatch.setattr(ap, "ROUND28_H2_HEAD", "f" * 40)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(ap, "ROUND28_H3_SUBJECT", "wrong subject")

    _assert_refusal(
        "SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_HEAD_MISMATCH", ap.build_reconstructed_context, request,
    )
    assert not request.reconstruction_root.exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "action",
    ["--build-reconstructed-context", "--archive-preparation-failure"],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("drift", ["dirty", "head", "parent", "subject", "time"])
def test_reconstructed_cli_routes_h3_identity_failures_to_specific_code(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    action: str,
    drift: str,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    request = fixture.request
    if drift == "dirty":
        (fixture.repo / "dirty.txt").write_text("dirty\n", encoding="utf-8")
    elif drift == "head":
        request = replace(request, replacement_head="f" * 40)
    elif drift == "parent":
        monkeypatch.setattr(ap, "ROUND28_H2_HEAD", "f" * 40)
    elif drift == "subject":
        monkeypatch.setattr(ap, "ROUND28_H3_SUBJECT", "wrong subject")
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(
            ap, "ROUND28_H2_COMMITTED_AT_UTC", "2999-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        )

    rc = ap.main(_reconstructed_cli_args(request, action=action))

    assert rc == 1
    error = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert "[SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_HEAD_MISMATCH]" in error
    assert "[PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_MISSING]" not in error
    assert fixture.request.journals_root.is_dir()
    assert not fixture.request.preparation_failures_root.exists()


def test_reproduction_postchecks_have_distinct_time_argv_tool_and_head_codes(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    records = ap.build_reconstructed_context(fixture.request)
    record = records["legacy_comparator_reproduction.json"]
    argv_tail = record["command_argv"][1:]
    executed = ap._parse_utc(record["executed_at"], label="executed_at")

    bad = json.loads(json.dumps(record))
    bad["tool"]["head"] = "f" * 40
    _assert_refusal(
        "SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_HEAD_MISMATCH", ap._verify_reproduction_record,
        bad, h3=fixture.h3, expected_argv_tail=argv_tail,
        t_pre=executed, t_post=executed,
    )

    bad = json.loads(json.dumps(record))
    bad["command_argv"][10] = "f" * 40
    _assert_refusal(
        "SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_ARGV_MISMATCH", ap._verify_reproduction_record,
        bad, h3=fixture.h3, expected_argv_tail=argv_tail,
        t_pre=executed, t_post=executed,
    )

    too_late = executed + timedelta(seconds=10)
    _assert_refusal(
        "SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_TIME_INVALID", ap._verify_reproduction_record,
        record, h3=fixture.h3, expected_argv_tail=argv_tail,
        t_pre=too_late, t_post=too_late,
    )

    bad = json.loads(json.dumps(record))
    bad["tool"]["sha256"] = "f" * 64
    _assert_refusal(
        "SOL_LEGACY_REPRO_TOOL_DRIFT", ap._verify_reproduction_record,
        bad, h3=fixture.h3, expected_argv_tail=argv_tail,
        t_pre=executed, t_post=executed,
    )

def test_reconstructed_archive_recursive_context_loader_and_embedded_closure(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    records = ap.build_reconstructed_context(fixture.request)
    entry = ap.archive_preparation_failure(fixture.request)

    archive = Path(entry["archive_path"])
    assert not fixture.request.journals_root.exists()
    reconstructed = archive / "chunk_context/reconstructed"
    assert (reconstructed / "scratch/source_definition.json").is_file()
    assert (reconstructed / "scratch/staged_definition.json").is_file()
    assert (reconstructed / "legacy_comparator_source_excerpt.py.txt").is_file()
    assert (reconstructed / "gpu_process_observation_late.raw.txt").is_file()
    assert entry["no_gpu_attestation"] == records[
        "preparation_failure_no_gpu_attestation_v2.json"
    ]
    assert entry["supersedes"] is None
    assert "prior_preparation_failures" not in entry
    assert len({*entry["authority"].values()} & {
        entry["authority"]["corrected_adjudication_sha256"],
        entry["authority"]["superseded_adjudication_sha256"],
        entry["authority"]["correction_adjudication_sha256"],
    }) >= 3

    ledger = (
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
        / ap.PREPARATION_FAILURE_LEDGER_NAME
    )
    assert ap.load_preparation_failure_ledger(
        ledger, verify_archives=True,
    ) == [entry]
    assert ap.preparation_failure_backrefs(
        [entry], cell_id=ap.ROUND28_CELL_ID, ledger_path=ledger,
    ) == [{
        "ledger_entry_id": entry["entry_id"],
        "ledger_path": str(ledger.resolve()),
        "archive_path": entry["archive_path"],
    }]


def test_reconstructed_archive_one_shot_and_consumer_tamper_closure(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    ap.build_reconstructed_context(fixture.request)
    entry = ap.archive_preparation_failure(fixture.request)
    ledger = (
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
        / ap.PREPARATION_FAILURE_LEDGER_NAME
    )
    archive = Path(entry["archive_path"])

    # The sealed archive event makes the reconstructed context one-shot.  A
    # second invocation is rejected before it can publish another ledger row.
    _assert_refusal(
        "RLCR_SESSION_LOG_INCONSISTENT",
        ap.archive_preparation_failure, fixture.request,
    )

    standalone = (
        archive / "chunk_context/reconstructed/"
        "preparation_failure_no_gpu_attestation_v2.json"
    )
    value = json.loads(standalone.read_text())
    value["attestation"] += " tampered"
    standalone.chmod(0o600)
    standalone.write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    _assert_refusal(
        "PREPARATION_LEDGER_INCONSISTENT",
        ap.load_preparation_failure_ledger, ledger, verify_archives=True,
    )

                "path": f"chunk_context/reconstructed/{name}",

        "authority": {

            "corrected_adjudication_sha256": "a" * 64,
            "superseded_adjudication_sha256": "a" * 64,
            "correction_id": ap.ROUND28_CORRECTION_ID,
            "correction_adjudication_sha256": "b" * 64,
        },
        "no_gpu_attestation": attestation,
    }
    _assert_refusal(
        "PREPARATION_LEDGER_INCONSISTENT",
        ap.validate_preparation_failure_entry,
        row, ledger_path=fixture.request.preparation_failures_root / "ledger.jsonl",
        line_number=1, verify_archive=False,
    )


def test_reconstructed_post_move_failure_state_is_structural_and_fail_closed(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    ap.build_reconstructed_context(fixture.request)
    construction_before = _tree_snapshot(fixture.request.reconstruction_root)
    session_before = fixture.request.session_log_path.read_bytes()
    _install_post_move_inventory_drift(monkeypatch)

    _assert_refusal(
        "PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_INVENTORY_MISMATCH",
        ap.archive_preparation_failure, fixture.request,
    )
    assert not fixture.request.journals_root.exists()
    archives = [
        path for path in fixture.request.preparation_failures_root.iterdir()
        if path.is_dir()
    ]
    assert len(archives) == 1
    assert [path.name for path in archives[0].iterdir()] == [ap.ROUND28_CELL_ID]
    ledger = (
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
        / ap.PREPARATION_FAILURE_LEDGER_NAME
    )
    assert not ledger.exists()
    assert _tree_snapshot(fixture.request.reconstruction_root) == construction_before
    assert fixture.request.session_log_path.read_bytes() == session_before
    assert not any(
        "FAILURE" in path.name.upper()
        for path in fixture.request.preparation_failures_root.rglob("*")
    )

    with pytest.raises(ap.PreparationArchiveRefusal) as caught:
        ap.load_preparation_failure_ledger(ledger, verify_archives=True)
    assert caught.value.code == "PREPARATION_LEDGER_INCONSISTENT"
    assert "archive evidence exists without ledger" in caught.value.detail

    preparation_before_retry = _tree_snapshot(
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
    )
    _assert_refusal(
        "PREPARATION_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_MISSING",
        ap.archive_preparation_failure, fixture.request,
    )
    assert _tree_snapshot(
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
    ) == preparation_before_retry
    assert fixture.request.session_log_path.read_bytes() == session_before

def test_reconstructed_row_without_archive_log_event_is_fs_post_inconsistent(
    reconstructed_fixture: _ReconstructedFixture,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    fixture = reconstructed_fixture
    ap.build_reconstructed_context(fixture.request)
    prefix = fixture.request.session_log_path.read_bytes()
    original_append = ap._append_jsonl_fsync

    def fail_archive_log_append(path, payload):
        if (
            path == fixture.request.session_log_path
            and payload.get("event") == "preparation_failure_archived"
        ):
            raise ap.PreparationArchiveRefusal(
                "RLCR_SESSION_LOG_INCONSISTENT",
                "injected archive event append failure",
            )
        original_append(path, payload)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ap, "_append_jsonl_fsync", fail_archive_log_append)
    _assert_refusal(
        "RLCR_SESSION_LOG_INCONSISTENT",
        ap.archive_preparation_failure, fixture.request,
    )

    ledger = (
        fixture.request.preparation_failures_root
        / ap.PREPARATION_FAILURE_LEDGER_NAME
    )
    lines = ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    assert len(lines) == 1
    assert isinstance(json.loads(lines[0]), dict)
    assert fixture.request.session_log_path.read_bytes() == prefix
    ledger_before = ledger.read_bytes()

    with pytest.raises(ap.PreparationArchiveRefusal) as caught:
        ap.load_preparation_failure_ledger(ledger, verify_archives=True)
    assert caught.value.code == "RLCR_SESSION_LOG_INCONSISTENT"
    assert "archived prefix mismatch: rows=" in caught.value.detail
    assert ledger.read_bytes() == ledger_before

### `E620` — source shard(s): alias-and-bundle-scope

<!-- FABLE5-EVIDENCE
{"excerpt_sha256":"ed85511820194d5c745a93f32230704c831d489c17f4222dc86f020b3487f82d","file_sha256":"ed85511820194d5c745a93f32230704c831d489c17f4222dc86f020b3487f82d","file_total_lines":212,"final_newline":true,"full_required_justification":"The utility is short and every input, hash, output, and CLI branch is relevant to distinguishing component bundles from M7.","id":"E620","kind":"file_full","lines":[1,212],"non_operational":true,"path":"tools/local_labels/freeze_label_bundle.py","revision":"WORKTREE","role":"decision","selection_reason":"The complete old freezer demonstrates a component-local point bundle that lacks present M7 dependency closure and cannot define whole-root authority.","supports":["B609"]}

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Freeze the M1 sm_86 label+trace bundle (plan gate M1).

Emits ONE tracked manifest that pins, per roster cell:
- the 5 v2.1-protocol label sidecars (sha256 each) + the aggregator's
  admitted means for the headline gate metrics;
- the NVBit trace identity (dynamic_trace.pb sha256 + stats.csv sha256 +
  admitted record count + binary_sha256 where recorded);
- the protocol stamp (v2.1: host -lgc 1350 + -lmc 10501 + --clock-control
  none + --cache-control all) and the registry/git provenance.

The manifest is the drift detector: any re-capture, re-build, or protocol
change shows up as a hash mismatch against this file. Evidence itself stays
in the machine-local annex; only identities are tracked.

Usage:
  .venv/bin/python tools/local_labels/freeze_label_bundle.py \
      --labels-root data/annex/repeatability_matrix_v21_ref_20260706 \
      --trace-manifest data/annex/m1_trace_capture_20260706/capture_manifest.json \
      --out eval/frozen_labels/sm86_m1_bundle_v21.json
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REF_CFG = "cfg=clock_none__cache_all"
HEADLINE = (
    "gpc__cycles_elapsed.max",
    "gpu__time_duration.sum",
    "smsp__inst_executed.sum",
)


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("--labels-root", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--trace-manifest", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    labels_root = REPO_ROOT / args.labels_root
    admitted = json.loads(
        (labels_root / REF_CFG / "agg" / "label_admitted.json").read_text()
    )
    excluded = json.loads(
        (labels_root / REF_CFG / "agg" / "label_excluded.json").read_text()
    )
    traces = json.loads((REPO_ROOT / args.trace_manifest).read_text())
    trace_by_slug = {c["slug"]: c for c in traces["cells"]}

    head_proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True,
        cwd=REPO_ROOT,
    )
    if head_proc.returncode != 0 or not head_proc.stdout.strip():
        print("freeze_label_bundle: git rev-parse HEAD failed — refusing to "
              "freeze without commit provenance", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    head = head_proc.stdout.strip()

    cells = []
    problems = []
    for cell in admitted.get("cells", []):
        slug = cell["slug"]
        label_dir = (labels_root / REF_CFG / "labels" / cell["arch"] /
                     slug / cell["shape_point"])
        sidecars = sorted(label_dir.glob("label_*_*.json"))
        sidecars = [p for p in sidecars if "run_manifest" not in p.name]
        if len(sidecars) != 5:
            problems.append(f"{slug}: {len(sidecars)} label sidecars != 5")

        # PROTOCOL VERIFICATION (never stamp what the evidence doesn't say):
        # every sidecar's measurement_protocol must match the pinned v2.1
        # reference; the bundle refuses to certify labels captured under any
        # other clock state.
        headline: dict = {}
        for p in sidecars:
            sc = json.loads(p.read_text())
            mp = sc.get("measurement_protocol") or {}
            if mp.get("ncu_clock_control") != "none":
                problems.append(
                    f"{slug}/{p.name}: ncu_clock_control="
                    f"{mp.get('ncu_clock_control')!r} != 'none'")
            if mp.get("host_persistence_mode") != "Enabled":
                problems.append(
                    f"{slug}/{p.name}: host persistence "
                    f"{mp.get('host_persistence_mode')!r} != Enabled")
            if mp.get("host_sm_clock_mhz") != 1350:
                problems.append(
                    f"{slug}/{p.name}: host_sm_clock_mhz="
                    f"{mp.get('host_sm_clock_mhz')!r} != 1350")
        # Headline means come straight from the admitted cell's own
        # unit_tagged_metrics (same evidence whose sidecar hashes are pinned
        # below) — a separate matrix_summary.json could be stale or from a
        # different roster.
        for m in cell.get("unit_tagged_metrics", []) or []:
            if m.get("ncu_metric") in HEADLINE:
                headline[m["ncu_metric"]] = {
                    "mean": m.get("value"),
                    "dispersion": m.get("dispersion"),
                    "repeatability_rule": m.get("repeatability_rule"),
                }
        missing_headline = set(HEADLINE) - set(headline)
        if missing_headline:
            problems.append(
                f"{slug}: headline metrics missing from admitted cell: "
                f"{sorted(missing_headline)}")

        tr = trace_by_slug.get(slug)
        if tr is None or not tr.get("ok") or not tr.get("contract_ok"):
            problems.append(f"{slug}: trace missing or contract-invalid")
            tr = tr or {}
        trace_folder = Path(tr["traces_folder"]) if tr.get("traces_folder") else None
        trace_ident = {}
        if trace_folder and trace_folder.is_dir():
            pb = trace_folder / "dynamic_trace.pb"
            st = trace_folder / "stats.csv"
            # Payload identity: the top-level pb is a tiny header (the bulk
            # lives in threadblocks/*.pb) — pin a sorted (relpath, size)
            # manifest hash of the payload tree, O(stat) not O(read).
            tb_root = trace_folder / "threadblocks"
            tb_entries = sorted(
                (str(f.relative_to(tb_root)), f.stat().st_size)
                for f in tb_root.rglob("*.pb")
            ) if tb_root.is_dir() else []
            tb_manifest_sha = hashlib.sha256(
                json.dumps(tb_entries).encode()
            ).hexdigest()
            trace_ident = {
                "traces_folder": str(trace_folder.relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
                if trace_folder.is_relative_to(REPO_ROOT) else str(trace_folder),
                "dynamic_trace_pb_sha256": _sha256(pb) if pb.is_file() else None,
                "stats_csv_sha256": _sha256(st) if st.is_file() else None,
                "threadblocks_manifest_sha256": tb_manifest_sha,
                "threadblocks_file_count": len(tb_entries),
                "records_admitted": tr.get("records_admitted"),
                "binary_sha256": tr.get("binary_sha256"),
                "via": tr.get("via"),
            }
            # Label<->trace binary identity must hold, and absence is a
            # problem, not a null to pass through silently.
            if not tr.get("binary_sha256"):
                problems.append(f"{slug}: trace records no binary_sha256")
            elif cell.get("binary_sha256") and \
                    tr["binary_sha256"] not in cell["binary_sha256"]:
                problems.append(
                    f"{slug}: trace binary_sha256 != label binary_sha256")
        cells.append({
            "slug": slug,
            "shape_point": cell["shape_point"],
            "arch": cell["arch"],
            "binary_sha256": cell.get("binary_sha256"),
            "n_repeats": cell.get("n_repeats"),
            "label_sidecar_sha256s": {p.name: _sha256(p) for p in sidecars},
            "headline_admitted": headline,
            "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector_pct": cell.get("cache_hit_rate_l2_sector_pct"),
            "cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct": cell.get("cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct"),
            "trace": trace_ident,
        })

    bundle = {
        "bundle_id": "sm86_m1_bundle_v21",
        "gate": "M1",
        "arch": "sm_86",
        "sku": "rtx_3090_ti",
        "protocol": {
            "version": "v2.1",
            "host": "nvidia-smi -pm 1; -lgc 1350; -lmc 10501",
            "ncu": "--clock-control none --cache-control all --replay-mode kernel",
            "driver_version": "610.43.02",
        },
        "source_commit": head,
        "labels_root": args.labels_root,
        "trace_manifest": args.trace_manifest,
        "n_cells": len(cells),
        "excluded_cells": [
            {
                "slug": c.get("slug"),
                "typed_reason": c.get("typed_reason"),
                "detail": c.get("detail"),
            }
            for c in excluded.get("cells", [])
        ],
        "problems": problems,
        "cells": cells,
    }
    out = REPO_ROOT / args.out
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(bundle, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print(f"frozen bundle: {out} — {len(cells)} cells, "
          f"{len(problems)} problems")
    for p in problems:
        print(f"  PROBLEM: {p}")
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

# Comprehensive sm_86 Live Data-Collection Campaign (RTX 3090 Ti) — Contract-First

## Goal Description

Scale the sm_86 ground-truth data-collection campaign from the 17-cell `portable_lcd` pilot to the **full sm_86-runnable roster** on the RTX 3090 Ti, producing the frozen corpus that M-SIM-1 and later simulator work consume: NCU labels (full metric vector), NVBit traces (the sim input), roster-wide SASS control-bits, calibration cards (pchase + new additive microbenches), per-metric repeatability/determinism floors, and a defensible typed-exclusion ledger.

The organizing principle is **contract-transition-first**: land the tracer ASYNC_COPY+ATOM address-exclusion flip as ONE fully-lockstepped, capability-versioned trace-contract transition (both flips in the same transition), keep the frozen campaign-M1 bundle as the pre-flip regression anchor, then capture the whole roster **exactly once** under the new address-carrying contract in immutable one-commit / one-roster / one-protocol / one-manifest chunks.

This is a **DATA-COLLECTION campaign only**. Building the M-SIM-1 eval-join, per-metric reporter, and baseline rigs is explicitly out of scope. No edits to existing validated code except (a) genuine bug fixes, (b) the sanctioned tracer flip plus its lockstep consumer widening, and (c) the sanctioned `freeze_label_bundle.py` widening (DEC-3); new files (roster JSONs, additive microbench probes, campaign-manifest + exclusion-ledger tools/schemas, supplemental-v3-only SOL shape-adjust wrappers after its pinned canary) are allowed.

## Current controlling state (2026-07-18)

ADRs 0001 and 0002 supersede older decision language in this plan. **Campaign**
M0–M3 are complete; campaign M4 is in progress; campaign M5 has not started;
campaign M6 and M7 are blocked. The canonical authority has 344 cells: 122
runnable, 222 excluded, and current defensible credit of 1/122 runnable. The
stopped 49-row revision and Task7/H3 capture-defect archive are zero-credit and
reuse-forbidden. The interrupted 53/201 SOL runnability attempt is separately
archived and canonical v1 is restored. Supplemental launch-set v3 is a separate
cohort and is live-disabled until a pinned canary passes; it cannot change
canonical campaign-M4/M7 accounting.

The three CUDA roles are independent and have no fallback: canonical C1
workloads use nvcc 13.3; supplemental SOL launch-set v3 uses nvcc 13.2; and the
NVBit/tracer artifact build independently uses nvcc 13.2. The supplemental role
remains live-disabled with its cohort until the pinned canary passes.

Task7/H3 continuation is authorized outside RLCR under the current live-campaign,
provenance, and hardware gates (`CONTINUE_PRESERVE_PINNED`). The sole
publication headline is `exec_cycles_gpc_max` / `gpc__cycles_elapsed.max`
(`CYCLES_ONLY_BINDING`): ≤10% MAPE meets the target, >10% and ≤15% is
floor-only, and >15% is publication failure. Cycles remain
`required_unimplemented` pending the checked-in aggregation-semantics study and
are operating-state- and protocol-bound, never claimed DVFS-stable. The seven
implemented simulator descriptors are reported secondary outputs and are
ungated.

The repeatability study supplies the noise floor used to interpret the cycles
accuracy gate and to contextualize the seven ungated secondary outputs. It does
not create a publication gate for a secondary metric or allow one to replace a
failed cycles headline. Archive-integrity, offline/frozen-hardware,
live-campaign, campaign-M7 completion, and M-SIM-1 are independent gates.

## Acceptance Criteria

The `AC-*` items describe the live-campaign completion contract outside RLCR.
All accuracy/coverage claims are against real-GPU NCU under the pinned protocol
v2.1; NCU values are targets/validation only and never enter model or card
inputs (Rule 1).

- AC-1: **Preflight, provenance foundation, and roster authority are established before any capture.** A preflight emitter records host + toolchain + clock state and gates capture; a machine-checkable roster authority enumerates the universe, the runnable set, and the excluded set. Canonical campaign accounting continues to consume restored historical SOL runnability v1. Any fresh SOL reconstitution, shrink, or runnable-count work described below belongs only to the separate supplemental-v3 cohort and remains live-disabled pending its pinned canary; it does not mutate canonical v1.
  - Positive Tests (expected to PASS):
    - Preflight manifest records git HEAD, `working_tree_clean`, NCU/driver/canonical-workload-nvcc/NVBit versions matching the capture pins (NCU 2026.1.0 / driver 610.43.02 / canonical C1 CUDA 13.3 nvcc / NVBit 1.8), separately verifies supplemental SOL launch-set v3's CUDA 13.2 nvcc pin (without enabling live v3 work), separately verifies the independent CUDA 13.2 nvcc used for NVBit/tracer and static-rebind build provenance, clocks == v2.1 (core 1350 / mem 10501, persistence on), a `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.toolchain/pb/lib` injection smoke that yields a nonzero contract-valid trace, and declared free disk > the authored trace-retention budget.
    - The roster authority manifest resolves to a total universe count, a runnable-set count, and an excluded-set count with `universe == runnable + excluded`, each row carrying `roster_source`, binary, app-args, shape selector, and sha256 pins.
  - Negative Tests (expected to FAIL):
    - A dirty unrecorded worktree, unlocked host clocks for the reference config, a missing `.toolchain/pb` runtime, or a missing trace-budget file causes preflight to fail BEFORE any capture runs.
    - A roster authority where any runnable cell lacks a resolvable binary/shape/app-args, or where `universe != runnable + excluded`, fails.

- **Supplemental-v3 contract — outside AC-1 and canonical campaign-M4/M7; live-disabled until its pinned canary passes.** It cannot gate, expand, or mutate canonical v1.
  - Positive test after canary authorization: SOL-ExecBench reconstitution reproduces a separate runnable/deferred split on this host (data via `download_data.sh`, environment via `uv sync`, CUTLASS via `CUTLASS_DIR` override) fingerprinted by a native-env hash; each of the 23 historical OOM cells is first re-checked under `--replay-mode application`, then, only if still needed, shrunk per `plans/sm86_sol_shrink_to_fit_fable5_answer.md` with full native-shape and regime provenance.
  - Negative tests after canary authorization: a `shape_adjusted` cell lacking its native-shape reference or typed failure reason fails; a shrink that cuts attention B·H below CTA saturation without a regime flag fails; a cell whose post-capture `dram__bytes.sum` deviates > ±30% from its footprint model without demotion to `reduced_representative` fails.

- AC-2: **The frozen campaign-M1 bundle is a green pre-flip regression anchor.** `eval/frozen_labels/sm86_m1_bundle_v21.json` validates and replays under old-contract semantics, byte-identical, before the flip.
  - Positive Tests: replay/validate the frozen bundle → 15 admitted / 2 typed-excluded cells; `smsp__inst_executed.sum` EXACT 15/15; L1 op_ld sector-hit-rate label-exact; all bundle sha256 pins reproduce.
  - Negative Tests: any new validation failure, changed admitted/excluded count, or sha256 mismatch on the frozen bundle fails (guards against accidental pre-flip drift or a premature contract change).

- AC-3: **The tracer trace-contract transition lands as ONE lockstepped, capability-versioned commit with consumer widening and synthetic tests — semantically correct for atomics vs async-copy, with BOTH flips included.**
  - AC-3.1: The producer flip stops the host-side drop of the addressed classes and stamps a manifest-level `trace_contract_id` plus a producer capability list (`memory_payload_classes`); the SASS classifier is untouched; the proto is regenerated and re-pinned in the same commit.
  - AC-3.2: Consumers are widened in lockstep to ENFORCE identity, not merely decode the enum: `import_trace_contract` extends its global-class allocation-identity gate to address-bearing atomic/async-copy records; `tools/sector_stream/generator.py`, HRD, `order_projections`, and the cache-access policy are aligned to the new payload classes; the Rust `sim/trace` reader enforces the same identity the Python gate does.
  - AC-3.3: Synthetic producer fixtures cover ordinary global load, **global atomic**, **shared atomic (ATOMS)**, **RED**, **LDGSTS (cp.async)**, and predicated-off memory records. The ATOMIC flip was implemented and tested first WITHIN this single contract transition; the ASYNC_COPY (LDGSTS) flip was adjudicated (source/destination operand semantics proven), widened, tested, and included in the SAME contract transition before the transition completed. "Atomic-first" was an internal implementation ordering only — never "atomic-only now, async later"; campaign M2 did not complete and full-roster capture (AC-5) did not start until BOTH flips were in the contract.
  - Positive Tests: a new-contract trace with an active global atomic or LDGSTS-source record carries `allocation_id` + `memory_op_class` + `data_width`; a shared-atomic (ATOMS) record is classified without being forced through the global allocation-id rule; the frozen campaign-M1 traces still validate with the capability absent.
  - Negative Tests: a new-contract active global-atomic / LDGSTS-source record with `allocation_id` absent or zero is REJECTED; forcing a shared atomic through global allocation identity is REJECTED; a `.proto` change committed without its pin regeneration fails `cargo test`.

- AC-4: **A new-contract canary proves the flip unlocked scorability without regressing exact metrics.** A small canary set (ordinary load, global atomic, shared-atomic/RED, LDGSTS) is captured under the new contract.
  - Positive Tests: the canary manifest shows the new `trace_contract_id` + capability list, nonzero admitted atomic/async records where expected, and no unexpected `unsupported_memory_path` rows; a previously-`na` tensor-core op_ld cell (e.g. `gemm_hmma_bf16`) and the atomic histogram L2 cell become scorable; `smsp__inst_executed.sum` and L1 op_ld exactness on the pre-existing cells are unchanged.
  - Negative Tests: a canary cell that still emits address-stripped `unsupported_memory_path` for the flipped classes fails; any regression in `smsp__inst_executed.sum` or L1 op_ld exactness on the pre-existing cells fails.

- AC-5: **The full runnable roster is captured once under the new contract at the v2.1 reference protocol** — traces + full-metric-vector labels + control-bits — with resume/idempotence, per-chunk provenance, and typed sampling for budget-breaching cells.
  - Positive Tests: for every runnable cell, admitted outputs contain a full-registry NCU label sidecar (the sm_86-available metric set), a contract-valid NVBit trace, a control-bits sidecar, a binary-sha256 join, and a v2.1 protocol stamp; the roster-authority count equals admitted + typed-excluded; re-running a completed chunk skips cells whose sidecar hashes already match; each immutable chunk emits a DONE-manifest (command, source_commit, dirty-state, tool versions, protocol, roster hash, budget hash, output root, pass/fail counts, typed-failure rows) and passes a pre/post source-commit equality check; a cell that breaches the trace budget is handled per the AC-9 sampling ladder (compression-first, admissibility-gated, wave-segment/reduced-shape, typed) — never silently truncated.
  - Negative Tests: any runnable cell present in NEITHER admitted outputs NOR the exclusion ledger fails the phase; a cell whose repeats span differing `source_commit` (mid-sweep commit → `label_provenance_duplicate`) fails; a budget-breaching cell captured without the AC-9 sampling ladder and its typed provenance fails; an incomplete trace (block coverage < 100% vs the launch `gridDim`) accepted without a `trace_sampling` sidecar fails.

- AC-6: **Calibration cards are refreshed/extended from the Fable-5-designed six-probe clock64 suite, Rule-1 clean, overdetermined, and stored as additive evidence in the current campaign scope** (designs: `plans/sm86_calibration_microbench_design_fable5_answer.md` for (a)–(e) + `plans/sm86_cp_async_timing_probe_fable5_answer.md` for (f)). pchase is re-run under the lock; the suite is built in **load-bearing order (b) port-width → (f) cp.async/LDGSTS timing → (a) L2↔DRAM fetch-granularity → (d) MSHR/MLP saturation → (c) achievable DRAM bandwidth → (e) L2 associativity/slice-hash**, at **execution order b, a, d, f, c, e** (f consumes (b)'s port + (d)'s MSHR verdicts, so it runs after both); (b)+(d) run as a Little's-law-coupled pair, and (f) = the F-L completion-latency + F-T streaming-plateau + F-B burst-issue sub-probes; control-bits are extended roster-wide. The sim `LDGSTS` event-model that consumes (f)'s constants (f1–f5) and the read-only attribution pass that confirms (f)'s provisional rank are downstream (FUT-6).
  - Positive Tests: each probe emits a measured value OR a typed bounded gap from the taxonomy {`RANGE`, `CENSORED`, `MIXTURE`, `UNRESOLVED_STRUCTURE`, `SURFACE_GAP`} carrying its full evidence curve + in-run positive/negative controls + confound verdicts, written as ADDITIVE evidence files (not transcribed into the byte-pinned `arch_profiles/cards/sm_86.json` in the current campaign scope, per DEC-3); every card constant is **overdetermined by ≥ 2 independent probe readouts that must agree under the hardware hypothesis** (Little's-law triangulation (b)×(d), RTT-contrast, persistence/Δ-contrast); control-bits sidecars exist for every runnable binary (0 unknown_encoding, or typed); a Rule-1 guard proves no NCU metric entered any card-input derivation.
  - Negative Tests: any card input traceable to an NCU metric fails the Rule-1 guard; a microbench that produces neither a value nor a typed bounded gap (a silent guess) fails; a card constant derived from a SINGLE readout or tuned against the simulator's end-to-end output fails the overdetermination rule (cross-probe contradictions are recorded as typed contradictions, never averaged away); an edit to `arch_profiles/cards/sm_86.json` transcribing a microbench value in the current campaign scope fails the DEC-3 boundary check.

- AC-7: **The full cross-protocol repeatability matrix is captured and analyzed by the Fable-5 uncensored determinism-study design** (full design: `plans/sm86_determinism_study_stats_fable5_answer.md`). Cells × {clock none/base/boost} × {cache all/none}, at **N=20 for the reference config (`clock=none`×`cache=all`) / N=10 for the five non-reference configs / escalate the reference to N=30** on a pre-registered trigger (modality/outlier flag, boundary-proximity, any out-of-range repeat, discrete-with-≥2-values); repeats collected as R shuffled sweeps, one fresh process per profile.
  - Positive Tests: the accounting identity `collected == classified + excluded_typed` holds and the study reproduces the historical admission set bit-for-bit via the imported `dispersion_gate` (the admission gate is demoted to a `would_have_been_admitted` reporting flag, not a filter); a NAMED uncensored `determinism_study` artifact (distinct from the admitted-only `matrix_summary.json`) classifies every `(cell,metric,config)` into the priority-ordered taxonomy {`out_of_range`/`vendor_defect`, `insufficient_evidence`, `multimodal`, `deterministic`, `quasi_stable`, `clock_noise`, `noisy`, `unstable`} via `sigma_rel` (d₂(N)-normalized for range rules, unit-asserted); pct-overflow rows are retained-typed (`ncu_pct_overflow`, never clamped/imputed) with per-(metric,config) OOR rate reported and the host-locked reference confirmed r=0; the two-stage small-N modality detector flags at tier-1 and certifies only at N=30; accuracy-gate denominators are the pooled P90 floor + per-cell override with the per-class rules; cross-protocol sensitivity is reported on the two SEPARATE axes (clock=instrument / cache=state) by equivalence testing; a cost/resume gate lets the sweep stop and resume without recomputing completed chunks.
  - Negative Tests: any admitted row produced by clipping or normalizing an out-of-range NCU percentage fails; an adaptive stop-when-CV-stable rule used for N (optional-stopping bias) fails; back-to-back same-process (non-shuffled) repeat collection fails the run-order design; a cell dropped without a typed exclusion reason (breaking the accounting identity) fails; a single-support outlier classified as `multimodal` fails; the classification statistic diverging from the imported `dispersion_gate` (a re-introduced scale bug) fails the lockstep property test.

- AC-8: **The full-roster corpus is frozen with a complete, defensible provenance and exclusion ledger.**
  - Positive Tests: the sanctioned widened freezer (DEC-3) emits, per admitted cell, every sm_86-available registered metric (mean + dispersion + repeatability rule), plus trace/control-bit/card-evidence manifests, source/protocol/tool hashes, and the `trace_contract_id`; a single typed-exclusion authority ledger classifies every non-captured cell with a reason ∈ {`arch_gate`, `semantic_mismatch`, `trace_unsupported`, `repeatability_failed`, `correctness_failed`, `calibration_inconclusive`, `host_capacity_deferred`} and satisfies `denominator == universe − Σ(typed exclusions)`; `shape_adjusted` is recorded as capture provenance on runnable cells, never as an exclusion reason; the freezer's `binary_sha256` check uses equality (the substring-idiom bug is fixed); the frozen bundle reports zero unresolved `problems`.
  - Negative Tests: a bundle with a cell in neither admitted outputs nor the ledger fails; a ledger row with a null/undefined `typed_reason` fails; a freezer that admits a cell whose label and trace `binary_sha256` differ (but one contains the other as a substring) fails.

- AC-9: **Trace-sampling for budget-breaching cells is compression-first, gate-routed, honest-by-construction, and golden-set-validated** (detailed design: `plans/sm86_trace_sampling_strategy_fable5_design.md`).
  - Positive Tests: lossless zstd compression + a compressibility probe are applied FIRST (contract hashes over decompressed bytes) and clear every cell that fits after compression; each still-breaching cell is routed by a deterministic admissibility-gate classifier (`coop_gate`/`wave_gate`/`atomic_gate`/`skew_gate`/`homogeneity`) to exactly one typed method with recorded gate verdicts; a wave-segment stratified-subset cell carries a valid closed-schema `trace_sampling.json` sidecar (method, gates, wave_model, strata, selected block IDs, estimator mode, `not_recoverable` list, `label_pairing`, tracer/stats-version pins) and HT calibrated-ratio estimates with stratified-cluster-bootstrap CIs meeting the stopping rule (rates ≤ 0.02 absolute half-width, counts ≤ 5% relative, ≥ 8 sampled segments, calibration self-check `X̂ ≈ X` within CI); the `sim/trace` reader fail-closes on an incomplete trace lacking a sidecar (`E_INCOMPLETE_TRACE`) and rejects a subset that rewrote `gridDim` (cross-checking the launch record against the sidecar `original_grid`); a golden-set fidelity run (8–12 small cells, full-vs-sampled at fractions × seeds) passes accuracy (p95 |R̂−R| ≤ 0.02 rates, ≤ 5% counts), CI coverage ≥ 90%, and sampling-induced error ≤ 0.3× the model MAE, WITH the histogram + few-wave negative controls correctly FAILING / gate-forbidden.
  - Negative Tests: a block-subset applied to a cell that fails `coop_gate`/`wave_gate`/`atomic_gate` is accepted (must FAIL — it must route to reduced-shape or `unavailable`); an incomplete trace accepted without a sidecar (must FAIL); cycles emitted as an exact full-shape prediction from a sampled trace (must FAIL — cycles are `not_recoverable`); a `dataset_shrunk` reduced-shape whose working set drops below the 6 MB L2 without the typed footprint flag (must FAIL); per-record or deterministic every-k decimation used as a sampling method (must FAIL — inadmissible); the golden-set negative controls PASSING, i.e. the estimator certifies a histogram-class cell (must FAIL the validation).

## Path Boundaries

### Upper Bound (Maximum Acceptable Scope)
The restored canonical-v1 authority — 344 cells, with 122 runnable and 222 excluded — is the sole campaign-M4/M7 cohort. Its runnable cells are captured once under the new address-carrying contract with the full sm_86-available NCU metric vector, the complete 6-config × N-repeat cross-protocol repeatability matrix, all three additive microbenches resolved (or typed-bounded), BOTH the ATOMIC and ASYNC_COPY flips landed and lockstep-verified in one contract transition, the pchase card refreshed as additive evidence, control-bits roster-wide, and a frozen corpus whose typed-exclusion authority ledger accounts for every non-captured cell. Budget-breaching cells are handled by the compression-first ladder (AC-9) — wave-segment subset only where the admissibility gates pass, reduced-shape or typed `unavailable` otherwise, with golden-set-validated estimators and negative controls. Fresh SOL reconstitution, shrink, or runnable-count work is excluded from this bound and belongs only to live-disabled supplemental v3.

### Lower Bound (Minimum Acceptable Scope)
The same restored canonical-v1 cohort, with typed records only where hardware genuinely blocks: both flips landed and canary-verified in the single contract transition; every canonical runnable cell either captured or assigned an authorized typed outcome; at least the reference-config full-metric capture banked for every runnable cell before the expensive protocol cross-product; microbenches that stay inconclusive recorded as typed bounded gaps; budget-breaching cells handled by the AC-9 compression-first ladder (at minimum: compression + the admissibility gate + the `sim/trace` reader fail-closed + typed `unavailable`/reduced-shape for gate-forbidden cells; the full wave-segment estimator + golden-set validation may narrow to the minority of cells that still breach after compression). At BOTH bounds the honest denominator, per-chunk provenance, the pre-flip regression anchor, and the typed-exclusion ledger are non-negotiable. Supplemental-v3 cells cannot satisfy or expand this lower bound.

### Allowed Choices
- Can use: existing roster-generator/adaptor sources (verification only; not authority to rewrite canonical v1); new additive microbench `.cu`/`.py` probes; new campaign-manifest emitter + typed-exclusion authority ledger + their schemas; SOL shape-adjust wrappers only inside supplemental v3 after its pinned canary; the sanctioned tracer flip + lockstep consumer widening; the sanctioned `freeze_label_bundle.py` widening (DEC-3); genuine bug fixes (e.g. the freezer substring-vs-equality `binary_sha256` idiom); supplemental-v3 SOL environment reconstitution (only after its pinned canary, never for canonical campaign M4) via env overrides / shims (`CUTLASS_DIR`, path-remap) + `uv sync` + HF `download_data.sh`; resume/idempotence wrappers around the existing runners; the AC-9 trace-sampling ladder for budget-breaching cells (zstd compression tier + `.pb.zst` + the compressibility probe, the admissibility-gate classifier, two-pass counting/dump capture, the wave-segment HT estimator, and the closed-schema `trace_sampling.json` sidecar); the `sim/trace` reader completeness fail-closed (a genuine bug fix — closes the silent-incomplete-trace hole) + the never-rewrite-`gridDim` cross-check.
- Cannot use: NCU values as model or card inputs (Rule 1); edits to existing validated code beyond genuine bug fixes, the sanctioned flip, and the sanctioned freezer widening; editing the byte-pinned `arch_profiles/cards/sm_86.json` to transcribe calibration values in the current campaign scope (DEC-3 — stays additive evidence, transcribed under a separate approved change); normalizing/clipping pct-overflow into admitted labels; committing while a capture sweep is running; capturing degenerate-fallback simbench kernels (arch-gated kernels forced to sm_86) as calibration or gate data; silent (untyped) trace truncation; per-record or deterministic every-k trace decimation (inadmissible — breaks ordered replay); block-subset sampling of `coop_gate`/`wave_gate`/`atomic_gate`-forbidden cells; emitting cycles as an exact full-shape prediction from a sampled trace; a `dataset_shrunk` reduced-shape that drops the working set below the 6 MB L2 without the typed footprint flag; building the M-SIM-1 eval-join / reporter / baseline rigs and the typed scoring-side guard (out of scope; FUT-1 / FUT-5).

## Feasibility Hints and Suggestions

### Conceptual Approach
Sequence the campaign so the denominator is knowable before the expensive work and the contract is stable before capture:
1. Canonical preflight + authorities: reassert clock locks; record host/toolchain; build the campaign-manifest emitter, roster-authority generator, and typed-exclusion ledger skeleton; author the trace-retention budget + sampling strategy; bind the restored canonical-v1 344/122/222 authority. Do not run or wait on supplemental-v3 SOL reconstitution/shrink; it remains live-disabled pending its pinned canary.
2. Anchor: replay the frozen campaign-M1 bundle under old-contract semantics; assert byte-identity.
3. Flip (under the current source, provenance, and offline gates): land the producer capability bump + `trace_contract_id`, widen the identity-enforcing consumers in lockstep, add synthetic fixtures; atomic implemented first, async-copy adjudicated and included in the SAME transition.
4. Canary: capture a handful of new-contract cells spanning load/atomic/RED/LDGSTS; prove scorability unlocked and exact metrics unchanged.
5. Reference capture: consume the byte-exact restored canonical-v1 roster; do not regenerate or replace its matrix during cleanup. Run reference-config full-registry capture (traces + labels + control-bits) in immutable, resumable chunks with DONE-manifests; apply the AC-9 compression-first ladder to budget-breaching cells (compress + probe first; gate-classify; wave-segment subset / reduced-shape / typed unavailable).
6. Calibration: pchase re-run + three additive clock64 probes + MSHR/L2-assoc rerun-or-bound + roster-wide control-bits; store as additive evidence, Rule-1 guarded.
7. Matrix: run the full cross-protocol repeatability sweep with a cost/resume gate; emit the uncensored dispersion artifact + determinism classes; type pct-overflow.
8. Freeze: widen the freezer to the full metric vector; emit the frozen bundle + all manifests + the exclusion authority ledger; assert the denominator identity.

## Historical design deliberation record

The following agreements and consultation references preserve completed design
provenance. They do not reinstate the retired orchestration loop or authorize a
new consultation; current escalation follows `AGENTS.md`.

### Agreements
- Contract-transition-first with capture-once (no double-capture) is the correct spine; the frozen campaign-M1 bundle is the pre-flip regression anchor; both flips land in one transition.
- The canonical denominator is machine-checkable and reproducible from restored historical runnability v1; a single typed-exclusion authority ledger defends it. Fresh SOL runnability/shrink work is supplemental-v3-only, live-disabled pending its canary, and cannot gate or alter canonical campaign-M4/M7.
- Calibration/card inputs must be clock64-derived and Rule-1 clean. NCU values may score or validate only after candidate constants and hypotheses are frozen; they cannot derive, select, tune, or transcribe those values. Calibration evidence remains additive in the current campaign scope (card transcription deferred to FUT-2).
- Per-chunk immutable provenance + no-mid-sweep-commit + injection-fail-closed preflight are load-bearing; the ~7k-capture matrix needs a cost/resume gate.

### Resolved Disagreements
- **"Lockstep widening" scope**: Codex showed enum-decode is insufficient — the identity-enforcing consumers (`import_trace_contract` global gate, `sector_stream` exclusion, HRD/order_projections/cache policy, Rust reader) must widen deliberately. Resolution: AC-3.2 enumerates them and requires identity enforcement, not decode.
- **Atomic vs async-copy semantics**: ATOMS (shared atomics) must not be forced through the global allocation rule and LDGSTS operand source must be adjudicated. Resolution (round 2): both flips land in ONE transition, atomic implemented first, async-copy adjudicated (task5) and included before completion — NOT deferred (the earlier FUT-2 async-deferral was removed as inconsistent with the operator scope and with AC-3/AC-4).
- **Denominator/SOL ordering**: canonical campaign M4 binds restored historical runnability v1 before capture. Fresh SOL reconstitution/shrink is supplemental-v3-only, remains live-disabled pending its canary, and is not a campaign-M0/M4 dependency.
- **NCU cost**: the ~7k-capture matrix needs a hard stop/resume + cost gate. Resolution: AC-7 requires it.
- **Card edit vs additive (DEC-3)**: freezer widening sanctioned; card transcription is FUT-2 (additive evidence in the current campaign scope).
- **Sampling strategy (DEC-1, Fable-5 design)**: the detailed method was designed via a Fable-5 consultation and shifted the center of gravity to compression + reduced-shape — block-subset is admissible for a minority of breaching cells, the histogram cell fails the `wave_gate` structurally, per-block is replaced by wave-segment cluster sampling (the sim replays traced placement literally), cycles are `not_recoverable`, the reader gains a completeness fail-closed (bug-fix-adjacent), and golden-set validation with negative controls is mandatory. Full design: `plans/sm86_trace_sampling_strategy_fable5_design.md` (AC-9).

- **Calibration / SOL / determinism designs (Fable-5)**: three further Fable-5 consultations landed and are folded in — the calibration suite reordered to **(b) port-width first** (the 2.8× cycles wall) with a 6th **cp.async/LDGSTS** probe flagged (`plans/sm86_calibration_microbench_design_fable5_answer.md`, AC-6); the supplemental-v3-only SOL shrink rubric (live-disabled pending its canary) with a **replay-mode-first** check and the **B·H-below-saturation → L2-inflation** hazard as the #1 corruption mode (`plans/sm86_sol_shrink_to_fit_fable5_answer.md`, AC-1); the determinism study's **anti-censoring architecture** (accounting identity, `dispersion_gate`+`sigma_rel` lockstep) with **N=20/10/30** fixed tiers (no adaptive stopping), the 8-class taxonomy, and two-axis cross-protocol equivalence testing (`plans/sm86_determinism_study_stats_fable5_answer.md`, AC-7). The 6th **cp.async/LDGSTS** probe was then fully designed (`plans/sm86_cp_async_timing_probe_fable5_answer.md`, task18), promoting it to **load-bearing rank #2** (order b → f → a → d → c → e); its #2 rank is provisional pending a downstream read-only attribution pass (FUT-6). No residual Fable-5-worthy open questions remain.

### Convergence Status
- Final Status: `converged` (two Codex passes + FIVE Fable-5 design consultations — sampling, calibration, SOL shrink, determinism, cp.async — all folded in; the four user decisions DEC-1/2/3/4 resolved; no `needs_user_decision` topics remain and no residual open design questions).

## Resolved Historical Design Decisions

- DEC-1: Sampling for budget-breaching NVBit traces.
  - Decision Status: RESOLVED — sampling is the DEFAULT, designed by Fable 5 (full design: `plans/sm86_trace_sampling_strategy_fable5_design.md`; seed prompt: `plans/sm86_trace_sampling_strategy_fable5_prompt.md`). The center of gravity is COMPRESSION + REDUCED-SHAPE, not block-subset. Ladder: (T1) lossless zstd `-19 --long=27` per-block `.pb.zst` + a compressibility probe (contract hashes over decompressed bytes) — clears most streaming cells outright; (T1.5) a deterministic admissibility-gate classifier — `coop_gate` (grid-sync → forbid), `wave_gate` (< 8 reconstructable concurrency waves → forbid; this STRUCTURALLY excludes the histogram cell, which has ≈ 1.5–3 waves), `atomic_gate` (> 0.5% atomics + cross-block hot-lines → forbid for L2/cycles/atomic), `skew_gate`, `homogeneity`; (T2) WAVE-SEGMENT stratified cluster subset — NOT per-block (the sim replays traced placement literally + enforces `issued == records_seen`, so independent block thinning silently dilutes co-residency/L1/MSHR/L2 contention), two-pass capture (pass-1 counting-only → offline `blockIdx` force-includes + online pseudo-wave selection in pass-2, counting kept on for ALL blocks for same-run calibration + a bias alarm), a ghost warm-up wave for L2 warmth, HT calibrated-ratio estimators (never average per-block rates), cycles `not_recoverable`, stratified-cluster-bootstrap CIs (≥ 8 segments); (T3) matched reduced-shape (`grid_stride_footprint_preserving` preferred; `dataset_shrunk` FORBIDDEN when it drops the working set below the 6 MB L2) — a different point in launch space, valid for calibration coverage, not full-shape prediction; (T4) temporal window (proven-stationary only); (T5) typed `unavailable` / `budget_limited_wide_ci`. Per-record and deterministic-decimation sampling are INADMISSIBLE. Provenance: a closed-schema `trace_sampling.json` sidecar + version-pinned tracer/stats. Honesty guard (bug-fix-adjacent, in scope): the `sim/trace` reader fail-closes on an incomplete trace without a sidecar (`E_INCOMPLETE_TRACE`) and forbids `gridDim` rewrites. The typed SCORING-side guard (`SimOutput::{Exact,Estimate,ReducedExact}` + scope-matched score fns) belongs to the M-SIM-1 eval (FUT-5, handoff AC-9). Fidelity validation with NEGATIVE CONTROLS certifies the estimator before use. See AC-9.
- DEC-2: The 23 historical SOL host-capacity cells.
  - Decision Status: RESOLVED FOR THE ORIGINAL DESIGN — any new shrink/reconstitution work is supplemental-v3-only, cannot modify canonical runnability v1, and remains live-disabled pending the v3 canary. `host_capacity_deferred` remains a typed supplemental disposition where a cell is still unfittable.
- DEC-3: Sanctioned-edit scope.
  - Decision Status: RESOLVED — the `freeze_label_bundle.py` widening is sanctioned in the current campaign scope; calibration outputs stay additive evidence files, with transcription into `arch_profiles/cards/sm_86.json` deferred to FUT-2 (`Source DEC: DEC-3`).
- DEC-4: Cross-day replication arm for the determinism study (Fable-5's optional across-session strengthening, `plans/sm86_determinism_study_stats_fable5_answer.md` §5).
  - Decision Status: RESOLVED — NOT included. The simulator will NOT be validated against archived reference data, so the across-session noise floor is not the operative denominator; the determinism study uses **within-session floors only** (no 2–3-day reference replication arm). The Fable-5 design's within-session default is authoritative.
